Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect within Axon Product Development to shape the architecture of our SaaS platform as we build new functionality and improve existing systems. If you enjoy making technical decisions, guiding engineers and working in an agile team, we’d like to meet you!

**Key about your role**

As a Software Architect within Axon Product Development, you shape the technical direction of our software and help teams translate complex business needs into sustainable solutions. You work closely with software engineers, product owners, business analysts, test engineers and fellow architects to ensure that architectural decisions support both our customers’ needs and the long-term evolution of the Axon platform.

You take ownership of the architectural integrity of key areas of the product. You analyse complex challenges, identify dependencies and technical risks, and guide teams towards solutions that are scalable, secure, maintainable and fit for purpose. By combining insights from different disciplines and teams, you establish clear architectural direction while allowing teams sufficient autonomy in implementation.

You are a hands-on architect who remains close to software development. You support teams with solution design, review critical implementations and help resolve complex technical challenges. You document important decisions and their trade-offs, promote consistency across the platform and ensure that architectural principles are translated into practical engineering standards.

You balance short-term delivery needs with the long-term health of the product. This includes guiding modernisation initiatives, reducing technical debt and improving performance, reliability, testability, operability and developer experience. You communicate architectural choices clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and help create alignment across Scrum teams and functional clusters.

We also embrace AI-assisted software engineering as part of our development lifecycle. As a Software Architect, you explore how tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex can support architecture and engineering activities—from analysing requirements and exploring solution options to understanding complex codebases, documenting decisions, identifying risks and supporting implementation and review.

AI is an aid, not a substitute for architectural or engineering judgement. You critically assess AI-generated suggestions, validate their assumptions and implications, and remain accountable for the security, correctness, performance and maintainability of the resulting solutions. You also help teams adopt these tools responsibly and effectively.

As part of a large engineering community, you actively share knowledge, coach engineers and contribute to architectural practices across the organisation. You encourage experimentation, constructive technical debate and continuous improvement of our software, architecture and ways of working.

**Key About Your Team**

The Axon Product Development department consists of more than 120 colleagues, organised across 9 functional clusters, such as Claims, Contracts, Financials and Request, and 16 Scrum teams.

As architect you will be part of one of those clusters. In addition, as member of the Axon Architecture Community, you work closely with fellow architects and share responsibility for the overall architecture, technical coherence and sustainable evolution of the Axon product. Together, you establish architectural direction, align decisions across teams and continuously improve our architectural practices. You also collaborate with architects working on other Keylane products to align architectural principles, standards and strategic technology choices across the organisation.

Together, they extend Axon’s functionality and continuously improve the product, ensuring it evolves in line with the changing needs of insurance companies and continues to deliver lasting value to our customers and their policyholders.

In this environment, you collaborate across team and cluster boundaries. You help teams understand how their solutions fit into the wider platform and work with engineering and product stakeholders to maintain coherence while enabling continuous delivery.

Check out our blog posts and videos to see what it is like to work at Keylane.

**About Keylane Property & Casualty**

As a leading European supplier of robust, highly configurable and customer-centric SaaS platforms to the insurance industry, Keylane offers solutions that optimise today’s business processes, unburden our clients and empower them to become future-fit and agile.

We provide and implement continuous upgrades, ensuring that our customers can comply with the latest rules and regulations. Combined with our commitment to backwards compatibility, this makes us a reliable long-term partner, providing a platform that continues to deliver value as customer needs and technology evolve.

  
  
**Requirements**  

* You are passionate about software architecture and engineering and enjoy turning complex business and technical challenges into clear, sustainable solutions.
* You have substantial software-engineering experience and have contributed to the design and evolution of large, business-critical systems.
* You have a strong understanding of software-architecture principles, design patterns, modularity, integration patterns, APIs and data architecture. You stay up to date with technological developments and assess how they could benefit the organisation and its products.
* You combine strategic architectural thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and are comfortable working closely with engineering teams and source code.
* You can evaluate architectural decisions in terms of scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, testability and operational impact. You identify architectural risks, dependencies and technical debt and translate them into practical recommendations and achievable improvement plans.
* You have experience with large technical ecosystems and technologies such as Java, IntelliJ, Git, Gradle, Angular and Docker, as well as relational databases and SQL, including DB2 and PostgreSQL.
* You communicate complex technical subjects clearly, create alignment across disciplines and document architectural decisions—including their context, alternatives and trade-offs.
* You enjoy coaching engineers and providing architectural guidance within an Agile environment without unnecessarily limiting team autonomy.

**Using AI**

* You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects. You can explain how you have used them to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, develop or improve code and tests, troubleshoot issues, or support code reviews.
* You understand how AI-assisted development fits into the broader software development lifecycle. You can guide coding assistants with clear requirements and context, including through reusable instructions, skills or agents where relevant.
* You critically review, test and debug AI-generated code. You can identify incorrect assumptions, security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues, and you remain accountable for the logic, architecture, quality and security of what you deliver.
* Experience with CI/CD practices and integrating AI-assisted development into those workflows is a plus.

* *A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and reference check are part of the application process.*
* *Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply*

 **Benefits**  

* Starting with a monthly gross salary for a junior candidate between €5,200 and € 7,000 (medior) and between €4,300 and € 6,200 (senior) based on 40 hours per week;

* 8% holiday allowance of your total gross salary;
* A profit share;
* A pension scheme, with the option to save extra;
* Travel reimbursement: Receive a mileage allowance of €0.23 per km or an NS Business Card, which can also be used for personal travel;
* 24 holiday days (with the option to buy extra) and 7 inclusion days, which can be exchanged with fixed Dutch national holidays, allowing you to take them when you like;
* Flexibility in working environment. As part of a hybrid working team, you will work partly from home and partly from the office. If you work in the office, a free lunch is waiting for you every day. If you work from home, you will receive a working from home allowance (€ 4 net per day) and internet allowance (€ 35 net per month);
* The possibility of working remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year;
* The possibility to lease a bike through our bike leasing program;
* A one-year contract that, subject to satisfactory performance, will be converted into a permanent contract;
* The opportunity to develop yourself at our Academy through courses and training, both professionally and personally;
* A comprehensive vitality offer to help you stay healthy. Read more here;
* An active and fun community of ‘Keylaners’. We also have after work drinks at our in-house pub every Thursday.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Wir besetzen aktuell die Rolle als **Senior Software Engineer (w/m/d)** zur Verstärkung unserer lokalen Teams **in Haan** für die Softwareentwicklung unserer Brachytherapie-Produkte. Mit Ihrer Expertise entwickeln Sie eigenverantwortlich Softwarelösungen für innovative Medizinprodukte, die weltweit den klinischen Alltag unterstützen und die Gesundheitsversorgung verbessern. Sie verantworten den gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess, bringen neue Ideen und KI-gestützte Ansätze in unsere Entwicklungsprozesse ein und arbeiten eng mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, um Technologien mit echtem Mehrwert für Patientinnen und Patienten zu schaffen.

  

**Ihre Aufgaben:**

* Sie verantworten die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung, Wartung und Optimierung unserer Softwarelösungen für unsere medizintechnischen Produkte und leisten damit einen direkten Beitrag zur Gesundheitsversorgung von Patient\*innen weltweit.
* Sie gestalten aktiv die nächste Generation innovativer Medizinprodukte mit und bringen Ihre Ideen von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung neuer Softwarelösungen ein.
* Sie analysieren fachliche und technische Anforderungen, bewerten unterschiedliche Lösungsansätze und entwickeln gemeinsam im Team zukunftsweisende Softwarekonzepte.
* Sie erstellen und pflegen die entwicklungsbegleitende Dokumentation und sorgen für die Einhaltung hoher Qualitäts- und Regulierungsstandards.
* Sie treiben die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse voran und tragen dazu bei, Effizienz, Qualität und Zusammenarbeit nachhaltig zu stärken.
Sie wirken aktiv an der Integration und Weiterentwicklung von Künstlicher Intelligenz in der Softwareentwicklung mit und gestalten die Nutzung innovativer Technologien.  

  

**Ihr Profil:**

* Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Bioinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung.
* Sie haben bereits umfassende, langjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwarearchitektur und Softwareentwicklung innerhalb eines regulierten Umfelds, idealerweise im Bereich der Medizintechnik.
* Sie überzeugen durch Ihre tiefgreifende praktische Erfahrung mit modernen Entwicklungstechnologien und -werkzeugen, insbesondere in Git, C#, C++ oder vergleichbaren Programmiersprachen, Werkzeugen wie Azure DevOps oder Jira sowie Benutzeroberflächentechnologien wie MFC, HTML5, JavaScript und CSS.
* Sie begeistern sich für den Einsatz moderner KI-Technologien in der Softwareentwicklung und bringen bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Anwendung von KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und Automatisierungslösungen mit.
* Sie verfügen über sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Qualitätsmanagementsysteme und verstehen die Bedeutung qualitätsorientierter Entwicklungsprozesse.
* Sie besitzen die Fähigkeit und Motivation, technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu dokumentieren und zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten.
* Sie überzeugen durch Ihre ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und arbeiten gerne in interdisziplinären Teams zusammen, dabei kommunizieren Sie souverän in deutscher und englischer Sprache.

Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. jobs.title: European Patent Examiner in Medical Device Engineering
jobs.description:
**European Patent Examiner in Medical Device Engineering (22631)**

  

**Duration of contract:** Five years, renewable (full-time)
  
**Location:** Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague)
  
**Application deadline:** 2 November 2026

  

**At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public.** As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future.

  

We are an inclusive, purpose-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO.

  

**Your role and impact**

As a Patent Examiner, you will:

* **examine patent applications** – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German)
* **analyse new inventions** to evaluate their novelty and inventive step
* **conduct in-depth research** using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art
* **apply legal and procedural frameworks** to make clear, high-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted
* **communicate your findings** clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties
* **collaborate with international colleagues** in a diverse and inclusive environment
* **maintain high-quality standards** with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour
* **contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem** by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts
  

**Your profile**

**We're looking for expertise in at least one of these fields:**

Engineers and scientists with experience in the design, development, testing or manufacture of medical devices and surgical technologies, such as:

* Minimally invasive devices: catheters, guidewires, delivery systems
* Drug delivery: microneedles, injectors and related devices
* Surgical devices: surgical instruments, powered and robotic surgical systems
* Spinal implants: pedicle screws, rods, intervertebral cages, disc prostheses
  

**You will thrive with us if you**

* have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience
* enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles
* are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law
* are analytical, detail-oriented and open-minded
* are confident using digital technologies and AI-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking
* value both independent work and team collaboration
* are comfortable making structured, evidence-based decisions
  

No prior IP(intellectual property) experience? No problem.

We provide full legal and procedural training to get you started.

  

**Our minimum requirements for this post**

* diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above
* excellent knowledge (at least C1) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required)
* work experience in industry would be an advantage
* citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation
  

**What we offer**

* competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience)
* 30+ days of annual leave + flexible working arrangements
* generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states)
* family-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support
* pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage
* examiner training: a comprehensive two-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six-week Academy programme on-site and delivered in English
* inclusive culture: 35+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment
* facilities: on-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location)
* top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community
* (see full list of benefits)
  

**What to expect next**

We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get:

  

* priority access to future vacancies
* exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner
* regular updates and insights
  

Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live.

**Process**  
The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire.

  

A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period.

  

In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process.

  

We recognise that AI tools may be used to support the preparation of job applications. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience.

  

During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

jobs.title: European Patent Examiner in Video Engineering
jobs.description:
**European Patent Examiner in Video Engineering (22633)**

  

**Duration of contract:** Five years, renewable (full-time)
  
**Location:** Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague)
  
**Application deadline:** 2 November 2026

  

**At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public.** As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future.

  

We are an inclusive, purpose-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO.

  

**Your role and impact**

As a Patent Examiner, you will:

* **examine patent applications** – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German)
* **analyse new inventions** to evaluate their novelty and inventive step
* **conduct in-depth research** using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art
* **apply legal and procedural frameworks** to make clear, high-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted
* **communicate your findings** clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties
* **collaborate with international colleagues** in a diverse and inclusive environment
* **maintain high-quality standards** with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour
* **contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem** by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts
  

**Your profile**

**We're looking for expertise in at least one of these fields:**

* digital video coding and compression (MPEG, HEVC, VVC, point cloud)

* video transmission (DVB, ISOBMFF, HbbTV)

* digital cameras, image sensors and camera control
  

**You will thrive with us if you**

* have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience
* enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles
* are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law
* are analytical, detail-oriented and open-minded
* are confident using digital technologies and AI-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking
* value both independent work and team collaboration
* are comfortable making structured, evidence-based decisions
  

No prior IP(intellectual property) experience? No problem.

We provide full legal and procedural training to get you started.

  

**Our minimum requirements for this post**

* diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above
* excellent knowledge (at least C1) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required)
* work experience in industry would be an advantage
* citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation
  

**What we offer**

* competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience)
* 30+ days of annual leave + flexible working arrangements
* generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states)
* family-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support
* pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage
* examiner training: a comprehensive two-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six-week Academy programme on-site and delivered in English
* inclusive culture: 35+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment
* facilities: on-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location)
* top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community
* (see full list of benefits)
  

**What to expect next**

We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get:

  

* priority access to future vacancies
* exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner
* regular updates and insights
  

Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live.

**Process**  
The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire.

  

A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period.

  

In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process.

  

We recognise that AI tools may be used to support the preparation of job applications. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience.

  

During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

jobs.title: Senior System Architect PEGA (all genders)
jobs.description:
#### **Über ]init[**

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.200 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.

#### **Deine Mission bei ]init[**

Als **Senior System Architect Pega** (all genders) realisierst du zukunftsweisende und komplexe Lösungen in Digitalisierungsprojekten auf Basis von PEGA. Gemeinsam mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Business- und Systemarchitekten (all genders) entwickelst du Anforderungen und Lösungskonzepte und setzt diese in moderne und benutzerfreundliche Softwarelösungen um. Gerne auch in Teilzeit.

#### **Das gibt es zu tun**

* Du bist hauptverantwortlich für die Umsetzung agiler Digitalisierungsprojekte im Public und Private Sector auf Basis von Pega.
* Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwirfst und verantwortest du effiziente und wieder verwendbare Pega-Lösungen in unseren Projekten und Presales-Aktivitäten.
* Du stehst mit Business Architects und der Projektleitung jederzeit in engem Kontakt und analysierst sowie optimierst bestehende Prozesse.
* Du beurteilst fachliche und technische Anforderungen und übernimmst die Abbildung von User Stories und Epics.
* Du beteiligst dich an der Konzeption von effektiven IT-Strategien und Zielarchitekturen.
* Du entwickelst die Pega Practice bei ]init[ aktiv mit und sorgst so dafür, dass unsere Entwickler und Projekte immer technisch auf dem aktuellen Stand sind.

#### **Das bringst du mit**

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Du kannst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Pega-Implementierungsprojekten vorweisen und hast fundierte Erfahrung im IT-Sektor.
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Lead Developer in Projekten gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung modellbasierter Geschäftslösungen und –anwendungen.
* Du hast eine aktuelle Zertifizierung als Pega Senior System Architect (PCSSA) oder bevorzugt als Lead System Architect (PCLSA).
* Du bringst Expertise in Web-Entwicklung mit, bspw. basierend auf Java oder .net.
* Du bist Teamplayer mit guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Zusammenarbeit in cross-funktionalen Teams bereitet dir Freude.
* Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

#### **Das bieten wir dir**

* **Because we care:** 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
* **Work with us:** Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
* **Learn with us:** Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
* **Grow with us:** Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
* **Ride with us:** JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
* **Start with us:** Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.

#### **Werde Teil des Teams**

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.  
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.  
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.  
  
*Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.*

#### **Recruiter**

Marina Makridina

#### **Über uns**

Worauf wartest du? Entfalte jetzt in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld dein Potenzial! Besuche uns für weitere Einblicke auf www.init.de und sprich mit unseren Recruiter:innen, die für all deine Fragen da sind.

jobs.title: Senior Software Security Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Das erwartet dich bei uns:**

* Du arbeitest in Beratungs- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten bei Kunden wie AXA, BMW, der Deutschen Bahn und ZDF
* Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst Softwarelösungen, in dem du AI-Methoden und Tools im gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess anwendest (z.B. LLMs, agentische Frameworks, Codegenerierung und Testautomatisierung)

* Du entwirfst und baust sichere Infrastrukturen in der Cloud (z. B. AWS, Azure, IONOS, Google) für die von uns entwickelten Anwendungen

* Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder in einer vergleichbaren Disziplin erfolgreich abgeschlossen
* Du bringst fundierte, tiefgreifende Kenntnisse im Software Engineering mit und fühlst dich sowohl im Backend als auch im Frontend wohl
* Du beherrscht Secure by Design, Zero Trust und andere Prinzipien der IT-Sicherheit hast diese bereits erfolgreich in komplexen und anspruchvollen Projekten eingebracht

* Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1 Level) und sehr gut Englisch (mindestens B2)

* 12 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr
* Fachlicher Austausch & Wissenstransfer: 14 interne Communities & Netzwerke (z. B. ML, Green IT, Architektur, IoT)
* Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten mit Homeoffice-Anteil
* Jobrad, Workation, Sabbatical, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss, Gesundheitsprogramme und vieles mehr
* Faires Gehaltsmodell: Finale Vergütung richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikation und bisherigen Erfahrung

Accso ist Digitalpartner für anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen nach Maß – mit **AI Native Mindset**. Wir verbinden exzellentes Engineering und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit pragmatischem KI-Einsatz, von der Konzeption über die Entwicklung bis hin zum Betrieb. Uns treibt eine klare Vision: **die Welt ein Stück besser machen**, indem wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zukunftssichere Softwareentwicklung und messbaren Impact schaffen. Dabei steht der **Mensch im Fokus** – bei unseren Kunden genauso wie in unseren Teams. Wir arbeiten partnerschaftlich, lösungsorientiert, exzellenzgetrieben, mit offener Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. jobs.description:
**Description de l'entreprise**

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

 **Description du poste**

**Develop at Ubisoft** is a mentorship program for students and recent graduates (with less than two years of experience) looking to grow their skills in Game Design, Audio, Programming, or Cybersecurity.

This initiative supports individuals from genders historically underrepresented in gaming and STEM.

**Develop at Ubisoft** is one of several talent programs we offer to engage and support different audiences across the industry.

**Please note: this program is a mentorship program and is not tied to any hiring process.**

From January to May 2027, selected mentees will work on a project based on a given theme. They will be mentored by volunteer Ubisoft developers, including from our mobile studios, who will provide feedback and guidance throughout the mentorship to help them develop their own personal project.

In the **Programming track**, you will develop and submit a game using either C++ or C# with a freely available development tool, such as Unity for mobile.

 **Qualifications**

**Eligibility criteria:**

* At least 18 years old
* Currently enrolled in studies, or graduated in Spring 2024 or later
* Fewer than 2 years of professional experience
* Legally entitled to work in the country of application
* Applications may be submitted to only one location
* Individual entries only – team entries will not be considered

**Additional criteria for Toronto applicants:**

* Must be a student or recent graduate
* Must be a resident of Ontario
* Must have attended a recognized school, college or university in Ontario

**This program is designed to support early-career professionals from underrepresented genders – female and nonbinary – in the industry. By submitting an application, you confirm that you meet and accept the eligibility criteria outlined above.**

Apply with your **resume, cover letter** and, if available, a **portfolio**. Please also select your **preferred track and location**.

 **Informations supplémentaires**

**Application period:** **October 1st – October 31st**

**Canada** (Montreal, Saguenay,Toronto);

**France** (Bordeaux, Lyon - Ivory Tower, Montpellier, Paris);

**Germany** (Berlin, Kolibri Games (mobile) - Berlin, Düsseldorf, Mainz);

**Italy** (Milan)**;**

**Singapore;**

jobs.title: European Patent Examiner in Electrical Engineering (Electric Power Distribution & Protection)
jobs.description:
**European Patent Examiner in Electrical Engineering (Electric Power Distribution & Protection) (22637)**

  

**Duration of contract:** Five years, renewable (full-time)
  
**Location:** Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague)
  
**Application deadline:** 2 November 2026

  

**At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public.** As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future.

  

We are an inclusive, purpose-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO.

  

**Your role and impact**

As a Patent Examiner, you will:

* **examine patent applications** – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German)
* **analyse new inventions** to evaluate their novelty and inventive step
* **conduct in-depth research** using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art
* **apply legal and procedural frameworks** to make clear, high-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted
* **communicate your findings** clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties
* **collaborate with international colleagues** in a diverse and inclusive environment
* **maintain high-quality standards** with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour
* **contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem** by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts
  

**Your profile**

**We're looking for expertise in at least one of these fields:**

* Electric Power Distribution & Protection: background as electrical engineer or physicist with similar expertise, preferably with background in electric power distribution (e.g. from renewable energy sources, such as photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, hydropower plants etc, to grid/power networks) via AC and/or DC lines (including HVDC), power conversion, energy storage, wireless power transfer and battery charging technologies (e.g. EVs/HEVs charging) and preferably Emergency Protective Circuit Arrangements.
  

**You will thrive with us if you**

* have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience
* enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles
* are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law
* are analytical, detail-oriented and open-minded
* are confident using digital technologies and AI-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking
* value both independent work and team collaboration
* are comfortable making structured, evidence-based decisions
  

No prior IP(intellectual property) experience? No problem.

We provide full legal and procedural training to get you started.

  

**Our minimum requirements for this post**

* diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above
* excellent knowledge (at least C1) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required)
* work experience in industry would be an advantage
* citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation
  

**What we offer**

* competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience)
* 30+ days of annual leave + flexible working arrangements
* generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states)
* family-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support
* pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage
* examiner training: a comprehensive two-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six-week Academy programme on-site and delivered in English
* inclusive culture: 35+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment
* facilities: on-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location)
* top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community
* (see full list of benefits)
  

**What to expect next**

We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get:

  

* priority access to future vacancies
* exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner
* regular updates and insights
  

Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live.

**Process**  
The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire.

  

A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period.

  

In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process.

  

We recognise that AI tools may be used to support the preparation of job applications. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience.

  

During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

  

**Ready to apply?**

Click **Apply** and take the first step towards a meaningful role in which science, innovation and purpose come together.

  

For tips on how to prepare your application, and to read more about our recruitment process, visit our Careers page.

**Key information**

**Job group:** 4

**Grade:** G7 to G10 (net (basic) monthly salary\* for this vacancy: EUR 7 076 to 10 164, depending on experience and location)

**Career path:** Technical

**Working mode:** Hybrid \*\*

**Pre-selection outcome communicated by**: end December 2026

**Technical Interviews estimated for:** October 2026 – January 2027

**Final interviews planned for:** November 2026 – February 2027

  

* *After deduction of EPO-internal tax (no other national income tax applies) and before deduction of staff contributions to the social security and pension schemes.*

*\*\*The position will require relocation to the country of one of the following EPO sites: Germany (Munich/Berlin) or The Netherlands (The Hague). The final location will be discussed later and depends also on team-specific needs.*

We welcome all applications for vacant positions. We consider each on its professional merits – regardless of your nationality, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, parental responsibilities, age, religion or belief.

  

Information at a Glance

> Work as a patent examiner

**Why join us?**
  
✓ See the latest inventions and enable innovation
  
✓ Work with inspiring people from a variety of cultures
  
✓ Develop yourself and take on an intellectual challenge

**What's in it for you?**
  
✓ A competitive salary
  
✓ Family-friendly benefits
  
✓ A good work-life balance
  
✓ Generous flexibility options
  
✓ Relocation benefits and various allowances
  
✓ Contributory medical insurance and pension schemes
  
✓ 30 days' leave per year
  
✓ Free gym access
  
✓ Social activities and clubs

**Who we are**
  
We are the patent office for Europe. We are proud to deliver high-quality patents and efficient services that foster innovation, competitiveness and economic growth.

**Our vision**
  
We will empower and motivate our staff to set worldwide standards in intellectual property. Our Office will be effective and transparent, respond to the needs of our users and be agile in managing the changing demands and conditions of a dynamic global patent system. Our work will contribute to a safer, smarter and more sustainable world.

**Our values**
  
All our relationships within our Office and with partners around the world will prosper through trust, fairness, mutual respect, adaptability, collaboration and a commitment to excellence.

**Our work environment**
  
We believe that diversity is fundamental to our success. Our inclusive work environment respects, values and celebrates our individual differences. We want you to be yourself at work.Join us on this exciting journey to a more digital, collaborative and sustainable organisation.

>

jobs.title: Civil Engineer (Development)
jobs.description:
**Civils Engineer (Development)**

**Location** - Prenton offices, Wirral (with site visits across SP Manweb)

**Salary + benefits** - £45,400 - £56,750 with annual review, comprehensive pension scheme (company doubles your contribution up to 10%), plus extensive benefits package

**Closing date** - Monday 26th October

  
  

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

  

Our industry is experiencing unprecedented transformation as we work towards Net Zero. SP Energy Networks is delivering multiple projects simultaneously, overhauling our network to enhance resilience and secure electricity supply for our communities' economic growth. As a Civils Engineer (Development), you will play a vital role in this transformation by undertaking site inspections of substation construction projects from 11kV to 33kV. You will ensure works are carried out according to approved construction plans, SPEN building specifications, and best practice standards. Using your professional judgement and technical expertise, you will provide design and construction guidance to internal Design functions and external Framework Contractors. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on critical infrastructure that powers communities across the North West of England.

  
  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Conduct regular inspections of building work at various stages of completion, measuring and sampling building materials to verify their quality meets required standards
* Confirm that construction work aligns with approved plans and SPEN specifications, while providing technical design assistance to SPM Design, customer engagement teams, and other teams during project design phases
* Become well-versed in the SPEN Civil specification for Primary Substation Civil works, reviewing end-of-project returns including as-built documentation to ensure civil works are properly recorded within SPEN corporate systems
* Review financial applications made via framework arrangements to ensure they align with works delivered on site
* Maintain quality and consistency of technical and construction output across all projects
* Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders and customers on behalf of ScottishPower, facilitating delivery of strategic goals
* Promote an exemplary safety culture, ensuring all safety legislation is implemented and delivered through activities and incorporated into project designs
* Contribute to team development by mentoring and training less experienced team members, graduates, and trainees, helping to build capability across the organization
* Manage a 6-month work bank of site inspections in coordination with design teams, overseeing civil works for Primary Projects in the delivery phase up to and including 33kV, typically valued at approximately £25m per annum
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* NVQ, HND, or bachelor's qualification in a construction-related subject such as building surveying, civil engineering, structural engineering, or construction management
* Membership of a relevant professional body such as the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), the Chartered Association of Building Engineers (CABE), or the Chartered Institute of Building (CIOB) is highly valued
* Solid knowledge of structural and civil engineering design approaches and material properties
* Practical familiarity with construction methods and experience across common forms of construction
* Capability to interpret construction drawings with meticulous attention to detail
* Knowledge of building regulations, construction processes, legislation, and requirements
* 5 years or more of relevant experience, with great attention to detail and pride in design quality
* Full clean driving licence (required)
* Experience working in the electrical industry is desirable though not essential
* Strong numeracy and computer literacy skills
* Effective communication capabilities that enable you to provide clear advice and guidance
* Effective problem-solving skills and the capability to work well within a team environment
* Capacity to meet deadlines consistently
* Negotiation skills and the confidence to provide professional advice and guidance to colleagues and contractors
* Availability to travel as required across the region to fulfill site inspection accountabilities
  

  

**What's in it for you**

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action - our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world - today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:

* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network - connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's ambition to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  
  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

  
  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Engineer specialising in Microsoft Azure to join the team on a short-term engagement. The role will support the hands-on build and deployment of cloud capabilities required for an initial Azure AI Search use case and the wider platform foundations around it.

This is a delivery-focused position. The successful candidate will translate solution requirements into secure, scalable and repeatable Azure infrastructure, with particular ownership of the physical build, configuration, automation and Terraform-based deployment pipeline. You will work closely with architects, AI specialists, application developers and platform teams to establish production-ready cloud services and leave clear documentation and handover materials.

The ideal candidate is a practical, delivery-oriented Azure engineer who can become productive quickly and work with a high degree of autonomy. You will be comfortable moving from architecture and requirements into a working implementation, while maintaining a strong focus on security, automation, repeatability, supportability and clear documentation.

Responsibilities:

* Design, build, configure and deploy Azure cloud infrastructure supporting AI-enabled search and associated application services.
* Implement and manage Azure AI Search, Azure SQL serverless capabilities, Azure Service Bus and containerised .NET workloads.
* Create and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including reusable modules and environment-specific configuration.
* Build and configure CI/CD pipelines for automated infrastructure and application deployment.
* Configure Azure networking, identity, access controls, secrets management, monitoring and logging in line with cloud engineering best practice.
* Support the establishment of development, test and production environments, including repeatable deployment patterns.
* Collaborate with solution architects, software engineers, AI specialists and security stakeholders to integrate services into the wider architecture.
* Troubleshoot deployment and integration issues, improving reliability, performance, security and cost efficiency.
* Produce clear technical documentation, deployment guides, operational runbooks and support materials.
* Provide structured knowledge transfer and handover at the end of the assignment.

Essential skills:

* Microsoft Azure
* Terraform
* Azure AI Search
* Azure SQL serverless capabilities
* Azure Service Bus
* CI/CD pipelines
* Git
* Docker and containers
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Azure OpenAI
* Azure Kubernetes Service
* C# / .NET engineering knowledge

Experience:

* Azure Platform Engineering
  + Strong hands-on experience designing, building and deploying cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  + Practical experience with Azure AI Search, including service deployment, indexing and integration with application or data services.
  + Experience deploying and managing Azure SQL serverless capabilities and Azure Service Bus.
  + Experience deploying .NET applications using Azure container services, such as Azure Container Apps, or an equivalent Azure hosting service.
  + Experience with Azure Storage Accounts, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  + Good understanding of Azure networking, including virtual networks, private endpoints and network security controls.
  + Experience implementing identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control and managed identities.
  + Infrastructure as Code
  + Proven experience using Terraform to provision and manage Azure infrastructure.
  + Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, remote state patterns and repeatable environment deployments.
  + Ability to structure Infrastructure-as-Code repositories and apply appropriate validation, review and release controls.
* DevOps and CI/CD
  + Experience creating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  + Experience automating infrastructure and application deployments across multiple environments.
  + Confident use of Git, branching strategies, pull requests and code review practices.
  + Containerisation
  + Experience packaging, deploying and supporting containerised .NET applications.
  + Hands-on knowledge of Docker and Azure container hosting services.
  + Understanding of container configuration, secrets, networking, logging, health checks and scaling.
* Desirable Experience
  + Experience delivering AI, generative AI, enterprise search or Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions.
  + Exposure to Azure OpenAI, vector search, semantic search or document indexing patterns.
  + Experience integrating Azure AI Search with structured and unstructured data sources.
  + Knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service where it forms part of the wider platform.
  + Experience working in enterprise-scale or regulated environments with established security, governance and compliance controls.
  + Knowledge of cost management, resilience, backup and disaster recovery considerations for Azure workloads.
* Expected Deliverables
  + Azure AI Search infrastructure built, configured and integrated for the initial use case.
  + Azure SQL serverless capabilities and associated data services deployed and configured.
  + Azure Service Bus messaging capability implemented where required by the solution.
  + Containerised .NET workloads deployed using the agreed Azure hosting service.
  + Terraform modules, environment configuration and state management established.
  + Automated deployment pipelines created and tested.
  + Monitoring, logging, security and operational controls configured.
  + Technical documentation, runbooks and deployment guidance completed.
  + Knowledge transfer and final handover delivered to the internal team.
* Success Measures
  + Cloud services can be deployed consistently through the agreed Terraform and pipeline process.
  + The initial AI Search use case has the required Azure platform capabilities available and operational.
  + Infrastructure is appropriately secured, monitored and documented.
  + The internal team can support, maintain and extend the delivered solution following handover.

jobs.title: Director Data & Analytics API Experience - Data Services
jobs.description:
**Director Data & Analytics API Experience - Data Services**

  

Background:

CME Group runs some of the world’s largest and most important trading venues, including derivatives exchanges, FX/FI platforms. The trading participants include leading investment banks, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, investment managers, and retail traders, as well as additional stakeholders such as independent software vendors (ISVs) and data redistributors. To support our unique data and analytics products, we are now building a unified API-first distribution framework, simplifying consumption and value extraction.

  

The Role:

We are seeking a key stakeholder for the CMEG External Data-Analytics (DA) APIs and distribution services. This is a high-impact, individual contributor (IC) role for an individual who can navigate complex enterprise systems and deliver a modern, developer-first experience. This customer-facing role serves as the technical link between our APIs and the customer, acting as a high-level practitioner who crafts SDKs and delivery mechanisms to make complex market data easy to consume. You will translate direct customer feedback into refined requirements for the product team while solving integration hurdles firsthand. By bridging these gaps, you will ensure our technical ecosystem is both highly functional and seamless for clients to adopt.

Our API First Vision

* Our external API is the singular point where our strategy, technology, and customer experience converge to create value.
* Our corporate DA strategy focuses on "activation," which involves externalizing proven internal IP and exposing it through a simple, consumable API, as well as adding net-new IP jointly developed with our customers.
* The API is our "single, unified distribution channel". It serves as the "handover point" where internal engineering ends and the customer or partner ecosystem begins.
* The API provides a "single 'front door'" for customers. By using a "unified API”, barriers to consumption are removed, integration time is reduced, development costs lowered, and a consistent experience provided across all data latencies (Real-time, Recent History, and Deep History), data types (time series, metadata, unstructured) and services.
* Internal users are recognized as ultra-valuable sources of feedback. By mandating both internal and external DA workflows through the same SDK, we create a shared experience for both sets of users.
In summary, our API is the "final product" and the “primary tool” moving CMEG up the value curve from a raw data producer to an invaluable source of insights for our customers.  

  

What you Will be Doing:

The focus of the work is on activation and will be organized across four strategic pillars designed to continue to build the foundation, enhance the customer experience, and align all our public offerings.

  

* Developer Experience
  + "North Star" Activation: Build a high-performance Python SDK that mimics the industry's best "one-line-to-insight" user experiences. Your goal is to move the user from installation to action in seconds.
  + Lighthouse Deliverable: This SDK will serve as the technical and UX benchmark for how all future CMEG IP is externalized and consumed. It will be the first deliverable and form your MVP.
  + Internal User Parity: The SDK must provide a 'single front door' for internal users, allowing them to 'pip install' and access BigQuery datasets through the same idiomatic Python patterns designed for customers.
  + Release Open-Source SDKs: Develop and maintain a suite of SDKs in popular languages like Python and C++ to make integrating with our APIs as simple as possible.
  Public Schema Registry: Implement a publicly accessible registry (e.g., Protobuf, JSON or Avro) that allow internal teams and partners to generate their own client software.

  

* Developer Collateral
  + Simplify Public Messaging: Partner with internal stakeholders to clearly communicate CME Group’s D&A value proposition.
  + Technical Documentation: Evaluate, implement and maintain an API documentation library and migrate existing fragmented solutions to it.
  + Publish Reference Docs: Create first-class, detailed technical reference documentation that serves as the definitive contract for all API behaviour and usage.
  Accelerate Time-to-Value: Develop practical tutorials, code samples, and dashboard templates to empower customers to self-serve and validate products rapidly.

  

* Data Plane
  + Expand Cloud Distribution: Work with our customers and product teams to extend our existing data offerings to meet customer cloud demand. Abstracting cloud specific technologies away and provisioning a common messaging layer.
  + Abstraction Layers: Work with our customers to better understand if/how we can improve data delivery for deep history and data sharing services so that accessing large datasets feels identical to a standard, programmatic API call..
  Enforce Schema Consistency: Use a centralized schema registry to ensure identical data models and field names across different services and latency tiers.

  

* Control Plane
  + Normalize Authentication: Work with our central technology team to ensure a unified CMEG credential system that retires legacy approaches and hides cloud-specific complexity from the user.
  + Downstream Distribution Technologies: Support external facing distribution technologies to provision products, including Bobsled, SFTP, Curl, email, etc.
  + Implement Group Wide Telemetry Tracking: Work with business intelligence teams to build the capabilities to track user activity With the goal to generate insights into user activity and product value.
  Full-Stack Execution: Be a key stakeholder in the "plumbing" of the API lifecycle, including GitHub governance, and CI/CD pipelines for PyPi publishing.

  

* Unified API Strategy
  + Technical audit: Work with stakeholders across the organization to conduct a survey of existing APIs (RPC over HTTP, JSON, XML Query, REST, WebSocket, S3, Pub-Sub, etc) across the business, to identify fragmentation, authentication gaps, and areas for consolidation. Survey peers and partners to identify best-practice in API design and user experience.
  Establish Versioning Models: Work with stakeholders to define and document the hybrid versioning model to manage API updates while ensuring stability for partners and customers.

  

Time Line

  

Major milestones for the work are split into three:

  

* Short (1yr): Publish the MVP of the SDK on github and PyPI, including support for Looker dashboards and other upstream uses.
* Medium (2-3yr). Design and publish a normalized multi cloud distribution framework.
Long (3-5yrs): Work as a stakeholder across the organization to streamline the process of normalizing APIs across CME Group Data Services and the wider organization.  

  

Who are we looking for?

* Exceptional Achievers & Problem Solvers: We are looking for high-capacity individuals who are driven to be elite at what they do. You must possess a strong technical foundation and a genuine interest in the mechanics of capital markets—understanding how data is used through futures, options, and cash markets.
* API-First Mindset: You are obsessed with developer experience (DX). You believe the API is the product and should be as easy to use as a "pip install" command.
* Cloud-Native Builders: Experience using, designing, and building SDKs and APIs in the cloud
* Polymathic Ability: You are comfortable bridging the gap between business strategy, engineering, and technical writing.
Python Expertise: Highly proficient in Python, with the ability to write clean, idiomatic, and robust code for public consumption.  

  

Technical Stack

* Environment: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Apigee.
* Protocols: WebSockets, REST, GCS.
Tooling: Python (Expert), OAuth 2.0, GitHub, Protobuf/Avro, SQL.

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our people combine technology, purpose and collaboration to create better outcomes and experiences for patients around the world. Join us and use your digital expertise to help shape smarter, more connected ways of working within a modern manufacturing and engineering environment.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Digital Solutions Architect to design, deliver and evolve digital solutions across data, applications, platforms and integrations.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful digital initiatives from concept through to delivery. You will work with colleagues across the organisation to understand business challenges, turn requirements into effective technical solutions and help embed digital capabilities that deliver measurable value.

You will have the scope to influence how technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric and Azure are applied across the business. You will also support citizen developers, share your expertise and contribute to scalable, secure and sustainable ways of working.

For someone who enjoys solving complex problems, collaborating with others and seeing their work make a real-world difference, this role offers variety, autonomy and the opportunity to develop your technical leadership.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Designing and delivering digital solutions across applications, data and integrations
* Translating business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions
* Developing solutions using Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies
* Taking ownership of solutions or components throughout the development and delivery lifecycle
* Ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable and aligned with agreed standards and design patterns
* Working collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver measurable business value
* Supporting the adoption of digital tools, including low-code and automation solutions
* Identifying and managing risks relating to solution design, data and operations
* Making considered design decisions based on long-term scalability and business impact
* Creating reusable components, integrations and automation solutions where appropriate
* Supporting and training citizen developers to expand digital capability across the business
* Guiding colleagues in solution design and delivery while encouraging shared learning and continuous improvement
* Helping to develop standards and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality digital solutions

  
**Work Experience**  

We are interested in the combination of skills, experience and perspective you can bring. You do not need to meet every desirable criterion to make a valuable contribution.

You will ideally bring:

* Experience developing and delivering solutions using Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric artefacts and Gen1 or Gen2 dataflows
* A practical understanding of data handling, processing and integration approaches
* Experience developing with or supporting technologies such as SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Azure Machine Learning, AI Foundry or Copilot Studio
* Knowledge of application lifecycle management, environments, workspaces and deployment practices
* An awareness of security, access control and data-governance considerations
* The ability to understand business needs and translate them into effective technical solutions
* Confidence working collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience supporting citizen development or training people from non-IT backgrounds
* A thoughtful, structured approach to problem-solving and decision-making
* Clear communication skills and a willingness to share knowledge and support others

The following would also be valuable:

* Experience creating reusable Power Platform components, integrations or automation solutions, including Power Apps Component Framework components or custom visuals
* Exposure to programming languages such as Python, JavaScript or C#
* Experience within a manufacturing, engineering or data-driven environment
* Familiarity with IoT, real-time data or event-hub data processing
* Microsoft certifications relating to Azure or Power Platform

  
**Benefits**  

You will join a collaborative global organisation where digital innovation directly supports healthcare and manufacturing outcomes. You will have the opportunity to influence how technology is used, contribute across a broad range of business areas and help steer the future direction of digital capability.

Our benefits include:

* Competitive base salary
* 26 days’ annual leave, with the option to buy up to 10 additional days and sell up to 5
* Up to 10% matched pension contributions
* BUPA Private Medical
* Bonus and Share Save Scheme
* Free-to-use on-site gym
* 2 paid volunteering days each year
* Opportunities to develop your technical leadership skills
* The chance to work on purposeful solutions with meaningful, real-world impact
* A supportive environment that values collaboration, continuous learning and diverse perspectives

**Who we are**

We are a team of more than 73,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**

When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Siemens Healthineers are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you require any adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know.

We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. Please create a profile within our talent community and subscribe to personalized job alert that will keep you posted about new opportunities.

**To all recruitment agencies**

Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.
