jobs.title: Estimation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Build your engineering career in renewable energy**

Are you a Mechanical or Electrical Engineering graduate, or an early-career engineer looking for your next opportunity?

Join Photon Energy, part of Project Better Energy, as an Estimating Engineer and put your technical and numerical skills to work on solar PV projects.

You’ll work closely with our sales and engineering colleagues to develop outline solar PV designs, calculate project costs and prepare customer proposals. You’ll help customers understand how their proposed system will perform, what it will cost and its expected return on investment.

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to work across Commercial New Build, Residential New Build and Commercial Retrofit projects.

**Your responsibilities**

* Understand customer requirements by working closely with the relevant sales colleague.
* Create outline solar PV designs, including design drawings and system performance simulations.
* Prepare accurate project estimates using our in-house pricing tool.
* Produce clear customer proposals covering system design, price and expected return on investment.
* Attend customer meetings alongside sales and engineering colleagues when required.
* Represent the company professionally and promote its products and services.
* Follow company working practices, quality procedures, health and safety requirements, and relevant statutory and regulatory standards.

**What you’ll need**

* A Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree, or an equivalent qualification.
* Confidence using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office.
* A basic understanding of renewable energy and enthusiasm for working in the sector.
* Strong numerical skills and close attention to detail when preparing designs and quotations.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with customers and colleagues.
* Good organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
* An appreciation of how accurate, efficient work contributes to customer satisfaction and commercial performance.

**This role is suitable for graduates and candidates with up to two years of relevant experience.**

**What’s in it for you?**

* Competitive salary.
* 37.5-hour working week, Monday to Friday.
* Flexible working once fully trained, with three days per week in the office.
* Reading as the preferred location, with Poole or Rochester also available.
* 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.

We work closely with other development teams within Information Services and share expertise and best practices to ensure a consistent approach across the service.

***Please read the role profile for the full details of this role attached below in this advert***

Cornwall Council’s ambition is to be an employer of choice, a high performing Council and a learning organisation. We commit to providing a reward and benefits package to attract, motivate and reward our employees. We offer a range of flexible working options to our staff. This helps provide our employees with a greater work/life balance. Whilst still ensuring that service needs are met.

  

Our core employee rewards and benefits include:

* a competitive salary.
* a defined benefit pension scheme, based on your career average earnings. This includes the option for extra voluntary contributions
* a generous annual leave entitlement with the potential to purchase additional leave.
* a national award-winning employee health and wellbeing programme
Employee benefits scheme giving employees access to a wide range of discounts to local and national goods and services

  

**Additional Information:**

Cornwall Council is unable to offer visa sponsorship or transfer existing sponsorship for this role.

We recommend saving a copy of this to refer to if you are invited to an interview

For more information or an informal chat about the role please contact matthew.smith@cornwall.gov.uk

jobs.title: Software & Hardware Developer (C# / .NET / IoT)
jobs.description:
**WE KNOW THIS IS A LONG JOB AD, SO HERE'S THE TL;DR:**

We're looking for a practical technical generalist who likes building things.

A lot of the job is C#/.NET, SQL, internal systems, dashboards and integrations, but those systems connect to real machinery, scanners, printers, sensors, GPS trackers, Android handhelds and hardware we build ourselves.

You do not need to already be a professional developer. If you work in IT support, infrastructure, sysadmin or another technical role and already code, script, automate or build electronics projects in your own time, we want to hear from you.

You'll get broad exposure, direct access to the technical lead, plenty of autonomy as you develop, and the chance to work on everything from agentic AI development to ESP32s, computer vision, 3D printing and industrial integrations.

*£29,000 to £34,000 DOE | Ramsgate | Primarily on-site*

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a practical, curious and technically minded person to join our small in-house technical team.

EPCC is a garment printing, fulfilment and e-commerce business, and a large part of our operation is powered by systems we design and build ourselves.

A lot of the day-to-day work is software development, writing software to run our internal CRM, dashboards, online ordering systems, production tools, artwork proofing, warehouse systems and integrations.

But these are rarely isolated, spreadsheet-style CRUD applications.

Our software connects directly to the physical operation of the business: production machinery, barcode scanners, printers, Android handhelds, shipping carriers, sensors and devices we have built ourselves.

One day you might be building a C# feature or investigating a SQL problem. The next you could be wiring an ESP32, soldering a sensor, 3D-printing an enclosure or testing a prototype on the warehouse floor.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We are deliberately open to people from technical backgrounds such as:

* IT support
* Systems administration
* Infrastructure
* Networking
* Electronics
* Technical support
* Junior software development

If you write scripts, automate tasks, build applications, run a homelab, work with Arduino or ESP32 boards, create electronics projects, or generally spend your own time making technology do useful things, we want to hear about it.

**Personal projects count.**

If you work in IT support but have GitHub projects, an ESP32, a soldering iron and half-finished technical experiments at home, you could be exactly who we are looking for.

**WHAT A REAL PROJECT LOOKS LIKE**

One recent project started with our goods-out system and developed into an end-to-end parcel tracking platform.

It involved:

* Integrating physical GPS trackers into our warehouse dispatch workflow
* Connecting tracker information with shipping-carrier APIs
* Automatically generating and printing return labels and instructions
* Building a customer-facing web interface where clients can monitor consignments in real time on a map
* Developing background services to monitor shipments and identify exceptions
* Creating workflows that allow us to intervene proactively when something does not look right

The engineering does not stop at "does it work?"

Displaying large numbers of live parcel locations also means thinking about the commercial cost of map tiles, API calls, polling frequency and third-party services.

We build with real business constraints in mind: cost, reliability, scalability, API limits, maintainability, performance and operational impact.

*A technically clever solution that costs too much to operate is not a good solution.*

**FROM SENSOR TO DASHBOARD**

Other projects cross the boundary between software and hardware in a different way.

You might build or integrate a sensor for a piece of equipment, then build the software that:

* Collects and stores its readings
* Graphs the data over time
* Allows users to configure warning and alert thresholds
* Generates notifications when readings fall outside normal limits
* Helps the production team understand what is happening

Because we build much of this ourselves, there is scope to work on the entire solution rather than one isolated component.

You may literally build the sensor at one end of the project and the dashboard displaying its data at the other.

**OTHER PROJECTS**

Recent and ongoing work includes:

* **Computer Vision:** Using machine learning to help detect garment-printing defects during production
* **Dimensioning:** ToF sensors for measuring parcels and dimensions
* **Machinery Monitoring:** Proximity and Hall-effect sensors for monitoring equipment
* **Fluid Tracking:** Ultrasonic sensors for monitoring liquid levels
* **Pneumatics:** Pressure transducers for monitoring compressors and pneumatic systems
* **Microcontrollers:** ESP32-based devices and low-power embedded systems
* **Remote Nodes:** Solar and battery-powered outdoor hardware
* **Displays:** E-ink integrations
* **Mobile & Scanning:** Android handhelds with integrated barcode scanners and thermal printers
* **Custom Hardware:** Devices designed around specific production problems
* **Prototyping:** 3D-printed enclosures, brackets and prototype parts
* **Assembly:** Soldering and basic electronics assembly

We have our own 3D printer and soldering equipment, so ideas can go from software prototype to physical device in-house.

You do not need previous commercial embedded, IoT or machine-learning experience.

You do need to be someone who looks at a sensor, microcontroller, camera system or interesting piece of hardware and wonders what you could make it do.

**OUR SOFTWARE STACK**

Our main stack includes:

* C# and .NET
* ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core
* Razor Pages
* Existing ASP.NET Web Forms applications
* SQL Server
* Entity Framework
* HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Windows desktop applications
* REST APIs and third-party integrations
* Git

You may also work with Android devices, barcode scanners, thermal printers, industrial equipment and other production hardware that integrates with our internal systems.

You do not need to arrive knowing all of this.

We can mentor someone with good technical aptitude and a solid programming foundation.

**AI-FIRST DEVELOPMENT**

We take an AI-first, agentic approach to development, using coding agents as a normal part of our workflow rather than treating AI as simple autocomplete.

We use AI to accelerate implementation, investigate unfamiliar code, prototype ideas, debug problems, refactor systems and work through multi-step development tasks.

Developers are still expected to understand the systems, review the output, recognise when the AI is wrong and take responsibility for the finished result.

*AI makes us faster. It does not remove the requirement to understand what we are building.*

**AUTONOMY**

We are a small team, and there is a lot of scope for autonomy once you understand the systems and the business.

The technical lead sets the overall architecture and standards, but we are more interested in giving you a problem to solve than prescribing every class, screen and implementation detail.

As your experience grows, we expect you to:

* Investigate problems independently
* Suggest better approaches
* Make sensible technical trade-offs
* Think about cost and business impact
* Understand how the software affects the wider operation
* Increasingly own solutions from idea through to production

You will work directly with the technical lead rather than through several layers of project management.

**IT ISN'T ONLY DEVELOPMENT**

Because we are a small technical team, there are no rigid boundaries between software development, support and infrastructure.

The role also includes some:

* General Windows PC and user support
* Printer and scanner troubleshooting
* Application support
* Deployment
* Basic infrastructure work
* DevOps-style tasks
* Investigation when something we have built stops working

We have external MSP support where appropriate, but most normal day-to-day technical issues are handled internally.

If a PC stops working, a label printer misbehaves, an application has a problem or a device you built stops responding, you may be involved in resolving it.

**There is no routine out-of-hours or on-call requirement.**

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We care more about technical aptitude, curiosity and problem solving than whether you tick every technology box.

You should have:

* Some practical programming or scripting experience
* A methodical approach to troubleshooting
* An interest in how systems work
* The ability to learn unfamiliar technologies
* An interest in hardware, electronics or physical systems
* A willingness to get hands-on rather than treating support or hardware as somebody else's problem

Useful experience includes:

* C# or another object-oriented language
* .NET
* SQL
* Git
* Python or PowerShell
* JavaScript
* REST APIs
* Windows administration
* Networking
* General IT support
* ESP32, Arduino or Raspberry Pi
* Electronics and soldering
* 3D printing or CAD
* Home automation
* IoT projects
* Computer vision or machine learning

*None of these individually is mandatory.*

**LOCATION AND ELIGIBILITY**

This is a primarily on-site role in Ramsgate, Kent, with occasional work at our Margate site.

Applicants must be able to commute reliably to our Ramsgate site, or be relocating before starting the role.

Own transport is beneficial due to occasional travel between sites.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK for this role.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply by email to itjobs@epcc.co.uk.

If you have GitHub repositories, personal projects, electronics builds, scripts, automations or anything else interesting you have made, include those too.

*The cooler and more obscure, the better.*

**RECRUITMENT AGENCIES**

Due to the nature of this role, we are handling recruitment directly and are not inviting applications from recruitment agencies at this time.

**We welcome direct applications from candidates.**

Please do not submit speculative CVs or candidate details without a prior written agreement with EPCC.

Where details are submitted without such an agreement, no recruitment fee will be payable and we reserve the right to contact the candidate directly.

Pay: £29,000.00-£34,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* On-site parking

Work Location: In person

Kent are looking for a Graduate Structural Engineer to be based in London, Aberdeen or Edinburgh.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?

Our Offshore Structures teams across the UK operate globally in both the Offshore Wind and Oil & Gas markets, working towards reducing carbon emissions. As a graduate in one of our locations, you will be contributing to a variety of technically challenging and exciting projects, from designing new offshore wind farms, sub-stations and floating concept designs, to helping clients improve their operational efficiency as part of our asset integrity management offerings, developing carbon capture and storage solutions, and even offshore visits to our client’s global installations.

**About our Graduate Scheme**

Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.

If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.

Our global graduate program offers hands-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.

**Application Process**

As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.

**Application Deadline**

All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.

**Recruitment Timeline**

Shortlisting and pre-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026.

**Eligibility**

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

**Hybrid Working**

We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.

**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**

**Skills & Responsibilities:**

* You’ll be joining a team with 4 locations around the UK with a global outreach, that actively encourage and foster innovative solutions and new approaches to our client’s problems. Your work could involve the following:

* Assessing and designing small and large scale multi-disciplinary greenfield and brownfield Oil & Gas projects as well as the next phase of the world’s offshore wind farms, whether that’s floating or fixed foundations or Offshore Substations, from concepts right through to operation.

* Developing life extension plans for ageing structures in the Oil & Gas market as well as power boosts and life extensions for Offshore Wind Turbine Structures.

* Improving efficiency offshore through inspection activities, development of risk-based inspection work scopes, risk ranking and review of anomalies, and operational support.

* Creating and interrogating finite element models in our advanced structural analysis teams using a variety of software and programming languages.

* Determining the fatigue and fracture reliability of structures with our highly specialised experts.

* Interfacing directly with clients, representing our teams to discuss engineering solutions to complex problems.

* Supporting our external markets, business development and work winning activities.

* Working as part of an integrated team, ensuring client interaction and project delivery from multiple locations.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer (Building Services)
jobs.description:
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

To find out more about our Building Services business click on the following link and discover what awaits you at WSP: https://www.wsp.com/en-GB/hubs/property-and-buildings

**A little more about your role…**

As a principal mechanical engineer you will be taking a leading role in a number of our most prestigious projects.  



**General**

* Work in a joint leadership capacity within a mechanical, electrical and public health (MEP) discipline team providing design and technical advice in a WSP project manager capacity on a wide range of projects.
* Supervise the completion of detailed designs and supervise the work of others in this function
* Consider the feasibility of the project and lead the overall feasibility study
* Take responsibility for and direct others in the production of detailed/performance specification
Act as the client’s key point of contact and responsible for overall project delivery in terms of client deliverables and internal KPI’s  

**Business Development**

* Provide excellent client care & the opportunities to develop additional business for the team
* Assist with developing the client relationship to promote new commissions
Promote WSP’s capabilities and expertise in the region  

**Management**

* Take responsibility for and direct others in the production of detailed and performance specification for the discipline subject to review by colleagues prior to issue.
* Development and line management of junior staff.
* Regularly brief the project team, explaining the appointment. Ensure contracts/letters of intent are in place for all projects before work starts
* Maintain project overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with the team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised across your associated projects.
* Hold regular team meetings to discuss resourcing, staff issues, H&S, quality, training & development & all other relevant issues, including UK & Board briefs in support of your Discipline’s Team Leader
* The Heathrow team is a close group of engineers working together in an effective and cooperative team atmosphere with a flexible hybrid working model to working practices. Our team find this a hugely beneficial feature of managing a healthy work life balance
* The Heathrow team are directly involved in mission critical building and infrastructure projects at Europe’s busiest airport.
* We will be looking to you to not only be a client facing representative of WSP, but also to lead an engineering delivery team in providing innovative and sustainable solutions.
As part of the wider WSP team we will be looking to you to incorporate our philosophies of sustainability, net zero carbon, digital design, modern methods of construction and smart systems into your design work.  

**Your Team**

* Our team is comprised of 10 engineers and part of a wider group of 60 engineers working across the Mechanical, Electrical and Public Health specialisms in Guildford and Basingstoke.
* Whilst our core team is Heathrow based, we have a ability of work from our Southampton, Basingstoke and Guildford sites, or from home, for some of the week. Many of our team choose to alternate the office they work in to suit personal needs.
* You will be reporting to our Heathrow Director, Huso Yildirim, and be responsible for both technical and project delivery elements.
You will have a team of graduate, senior and principle engineers in supporting roles around you, as well as dedicated BIM and Sustainability specialists to contribute to your projects.  

**What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…**

* Have the ability to work as part of a team, but also take a leading role in managing engineers towards the delivery of our key projects.
* Be able to apply technical judgment and resourcefulness to feasibility studies, concept, scheme and detailed design, as well as construction support phases of projects
* Able to represent WSP to our clients, whilst also understanding and delivering client needs in engineering solutions.
* Have a working knowledge of UK mechanical building services design, including relevant standards, codes and regulations and a proven track record of delivering a variety of UK Building Services MEP (Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing) projects both in terms of scale and sector.
* Have a working understanding of latest mechanical design software packages to allow the allocation / direction of work on projects.
* Proven understanding of working with Revit MEP or other 3D design software to allow the allocation / direction of work on projects.
* Be able to manage the technical, cost and programme elements of project delivery.
Must be able to obtain UK vetting level of Security Check (SC)  

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**  
  
Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 83,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
  
  
**With us, you can. Apply today.**

#LI-CH1

  

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

**Inclusivity & Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

**Health & Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

**Flex your time**

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

**Your development**

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

**#WeAreWSP**

*Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Are you ready to join the forefront of technology innovation with Netcompany?

As one of the fastest growing technology companies, we are disrupting the marketplace and revolutionizing the way businesses operate. Our vision is to be the leading digital challenger in Europe whilst evolving the next generation of IT consulting.

Operating across both public and private sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of services from application development and seamless cloud migration to program delivery and service operations, our offerings are designed to meet diverse business needs

 **Job Description**

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will play a key role in building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning and AI solutions that solve real business problems for our clients. Working alongside senior data scientists, engineers, and consultants, you will contribute to solutions across the full development lifecycle, from data preparation and model development through to production deployment and monitoring.

* Solution Development: Support the design and implementation of data science and AI solutions, translating defined requirements into working technical components.
* Modelling & Analysis: Apply established data science and machine learning techniques to analyse data and solve business problems under the guidance of senior team members.
* Production & MLOps: Build, test, and help deploy machine learning models into production environments. Contribute to the design and maintenance of MLOps pipelines to ensure solutions are scalable and maintainable.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with clients and internal teams to understand requirements and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ethical AI & Governance: Apply responsible AI principles and support adherence to governance and compliance standards in AI/ML development.
* Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Mentor and guide junior data scientists and engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

 **Qualifications**  

* Proficiency in Python and C#. SQL or R is a plus.
* Experience with Cloud AI services such as Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI.
* Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Practical knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as regression, decision trees, random forest, XGBoost, k-means, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting.
* Working understanding of model evaluation and explainability concepts, e.g. overfitting, bias, cross-validation.
* Experience developing and implementing end to end observability and monitoring for AI.
* Experience working with large, complex, or messy datasets.

Knowledge of Public Sector:

* Understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing public sector organisations.
* Experience working with public sector data.
* Knowledge of public sector regulations and compliance requirements.

Desired Skills:

* Must be eligible for Security Clearance
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Commitment to continuous learning and development.

  
**Additional Information**

**Benefits:**

* Hybrid working model with some flexible working
* 25 days’ holiday
* Private Medical Health care via Vitality
* Pension contribution, Life Assurance
* Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
* A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
* Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.

Join Netcompany, where we proudly hold the 5th position on the esteemed UK Top 50 Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Awards for 2024.

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe's most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.

Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us. We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com.

#LI-RS1

jobs.description:
**Details**
-----------

### **Reference number**

477053

### **Salary**

£35,232 - £48,561

National £35,232-£45,831, London £38,021-£48,561
  
Please ensure that you read the Pay and Reward information for civil service and internal colleagues before applying.

A Civil Service Pension with an employer contribution of 28.97%

GBP

Higher Executive Officer

Level 2A

### **Contract type**

Permanent

Infrastructure

### **Type of role**

Engineering

### **Working pattern**

Flexible working, Full-time

### **Number of jobs available**

1

**Contents**
------------

* Location
* About the job
* Benefits
* Things you need to know
* Apply and further information

**Location**
------------

Successful candidates may be based in any of our office locations  Cardiff, Glasgow, or London. We especially welcome applicants from Cardiff and Glasgow.

**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**

Join Ofgem and help shape the future of energy in Great Britain.

At Ofgem, we work on behalf of energy consumers to ensure households and businesses can rely on a safe, affordable and sustainable energy supply. As the energy sector undergoes unprecedented transformation, we're playing a critical role in delivering the UK's Net Zero ambitions. By joining us, you'll contribute to building and supporting the digital infrastructure that underpins this transition.

We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to support and maintain Ofgem's cloud and on-premises infrastructure services. This is an exciting opportunity to work across a diverse technology landscape, combining traditional infrastructure with modern cloud platforms and automation technologies.

In this role, you'll help ensure the reliable operation of our Microsoft Azure-focused environment, supporting virtualised services, infrastructure deployments, monitoring activities, patching programmes, and incident resolution. You'll work closely with senior engineers, architects, suppliers and business stakeholders to maintain secure, resilient and high-performing services.

You'll contribute to both business-as-usual operations and project delivery, supporting infrastructure improvements and the adoption of modern technologies such as Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform. From server provisioning and system maintenance to monitoring, troubleshooting and disaster recovery activities, you'll play a key role in ensuring our services remain robust, compliant and responsive to business needs.

We're seeking someone with experience supporting infrastructure environments, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering excellent service. Knowledge of cloud technologies, virtualisation, monitoring tools and modern infrastructure practices would be advantageous.

At Ofgem, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to bring their authentic selves to work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

If you're looking for a role where your technical expertise can make a real impact on the future of energy, we'd love to hear from you.

SC is required for this role. Information and eligibility guidance can be found here: SC - Guidance Pack for Applicants - GOV.UK

### **Job description**

**Key Responsibilities**
   
Provide hands-on support for cloud infrastructure services, ensuring systems operate reliably and meet service needs.
   
Contribute to deployments, configuration activities and routine monitoring, helping identify issues early and supporting system health.
   
Assist in resolving incidents by executing troubleshooting tasks, escalating appropriately, and contributing to problem investigations.
   
Carry out scheduled deployments, patching, updates, and routine maintenance to ensure systems remain compliant, secure, and operational.
   
Support improvements to tools, automation and processes by contributing suggestions, testing changes, and applying established practices.
   
Maintain accurate and precise documentation that supports operational continuity, knowledge sharing, and compliance.

**Key Outputs and Deliverables**
   
Provide cloud support and on-premises infrastructure environments.
   
Execute patching, updates, and routine maintenance activities.
   
Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health checks.
   
Assist with deployments, configuration updates, and service integrations.
   
Maintain clear technical documentation for operational continuity.

### **Person specification**

Essential Criteria:

In the event of receiving a large number of applications an initial sift may take place on just the identified lead criteria indicated below.


Experience carrying out infrastructure maintenance activities such as deployments, patching, upgrades, monitoring, backup and recovery, and assisting with incident resolution. **(LEAD)**
   
Experience supporting and maintaining cloud and infrastructure services, including Microsoft Azure to ensure services remain secure, available and operational. **(LEAD)**
   
Experience using automation, scripting, or Infrastructure-as-Code technologies tools to improve operational efficiency and stability. **(LEAD)**
   
Experience investigating and resolving infrastructure issues, escalating where appropriate, and working collaboratively with colleagues, suppliers and stakeholders to support effective service delivery.
   
Holds, or can obtain within 6 months of appointment, the Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate certification (or equivalent cloud infrastructure certification).

### **Behaviours**

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

* Working Together
* Managing a Quality Service
* Delivering at Pace

### **Technical skills**

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:

* You will be asked to deliver a technical presentation at interview stage.

**Benefits**
------------

Alongside your salary of £35,232, OFGEM contributes £10,206 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .

Ofgem can offer you a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes; 30 days annual leave after 2 years; Excellent training and development opportunities; The opportunity to join the generous Civil Service pension which also includes a valuable range of benefits; hybrid working (currently 1 day a week in the office but this is kept under review), flexible working hours and family friendly policies. Plus lots of other benefits including clean and bright offices based centrally, engaged networks and teams and an opportunity to contribute to our ambitious and important targets of establishing a Net Zero energy system by 2050. This exciting blend of professional challenge and personal reward identifies career opportunities at Ofgem as something to get excited about.

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

### **Selection process details**

This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

When you press the Apply now button, you will be directed to a Civil Service test  guidance for this can be found here Civil Service online tests - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk). The test you are due to take is not timed and you can complete it at your own pace. Upon passing the test, you will be asked to complete personal details (not seen by the sift panel), your career history and qualifications.

You will then be asked to provide personal statement evidencing how you meet the essential criteria listed in the role profile. Please ensure you demonstrate clearly, within your supporting statement, how you meet each of the criteria listed in the role profile.

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. You must ensure that any evidence submitted as part of your application or used during interview, including your CV and any statements or examples, are truthful and factually accurate. Ofgem takes any incidences of cheating very seriously. Please ensure all examples provided are of your own experience. Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant applications will be withdrawn from the process. Please note that plagiarism can include presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own.

Please refer to Civil Service candidate advice on the acceptable use of artificial intelligence within the recruitment and selection process - Artificial intelligence and recruitment , Civil Service Careers

*The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by* *[* *https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn**].*

  
  
  
Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

### **Security**

Successful candidates must undergo a basic (or equivalent) criminal record check.

Successful candidates must meet the security requirements before they can be appointed. The level of security needed is security check .
  
  
See our vetting charter .

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

### **Nationality requirements**

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

* UK nationals
* nationals of the Republic of Ireland
* nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
* individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
* Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements

### **Working for the Civil Service**

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.
  
  
We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles .

The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.

The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

### **Diversity and Inclusion**

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .

**Apply and further information**
---------------------------------

jobs.description:

From medication deliveries to specialist clinical nursing support, including injection training and the administration of IV and infusion therapies, we are dedicated to making healthcare more accessible and convenient for those who need it most.

Supporting over 240,000 patients across a wide range of therapy areas, our experienced and compassionate teams work with individuals living with both rare and more common conditions. Our mission is to make patients' lives easier by removing the stress of managing treatment and providing reassurance that they are receiving safe, high-quality care every step of the way.

We are currently looking for a **Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Developer to join our IT Development team on a 6 month, fixed-term contract**

If you are passionate about making a real difference and are looking for a role with purpose, where your work has a positive impact on patients' everyday lives, we would love to hear from you.

**Main Responsibilities**

Support and improve existing Dynamics 365, Dataverse and Power Platform solutions under the Business Solutions & Automation Manager / D365 Lead. The role focuses on configuration, automation, investigation, testing and documentation. Coding is useful but not essential

**What experience and skills are we looking for?**

* Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse or a comparable business platform.
* Strong analytical thinking and a logical approach to investigation.

* Identifying opportunities for improvement and delivering pragmatic, agile solutions that support clinical operations

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Quality Engineers are at the heart of every development team in Trayport and are key to the delivery of our software. Candidates should be passionate about delivering high quality software and committed to ensuring our clients have the best user experience possible. Quality Engineers at Trayport share an unrivaled passion for quality, software testing and love nothing more than voraciously and persistently hunting down bugs, investigating potential issues and also preventing them from being introduced in the first place to help to make our software the best it can be.
  
  
Our Quality Engineers use a combination of shift-left and shift-right testing techniques, exploratory testing, technical testing and test automation to build quality into our software, working closely with the rest of their team and coaching others on how to write better software. For us, teamwork is everything. We listen to each other, we adapt, we evolve and we strive to innovate. We are making significant investments in our business and we will invest in you.

**Our Tech Stack/Tools**
========================

  

* C#
* .Net
* Event Driven Architecture
* Highly distributed systems

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

* Defining and executing the quality and testing strategy for your team, coaching other team members to ensure software quality is considered throughout the development process
* Design test charters and perform session based exploratory testing to find unique bugs that could only be discovered by the most creative people
* Working closely with the Product Team and developers to ensure we are building the right software for our customers and embracing a shift-left approach to software quality
* Enhancing and utilising our observability stack and embracing a shift-right approach to software quality
* Implement risk based testing strategies to ensure we are approaching quality at the correct level
* Actively grow our culture of quality and engage in quality related topics across the organisation
* Pair with your teammates, expand your knowledge and contribute to the delivery of high-quality, tested, maintainable code
* Investigate and perform root cause analysis on bugs, putting on your detective hat and diving into the code when necessary
* Discuss and design software architecture and contribute to whiteboard sessions
* Help developers brainstorm what should be covered in the automated tests and contributing to automation where appropriate
* Acting as a point of contact regarding product knowledge from various members of the business
* Attend knowledge sharing sessions with other testers and developers across the company to share techniques and product knowledge
* Leverage AI assistants like GitHub Copilot and Gemini to build custom internal testing tools, accelerate test script creation, and optimise overall engineering workflows.

**The Person**
==============

  

* A strong background in software quality and exploratory testing
* Interested in all things technical with a passion for technology
* An inquisitive nature, with excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Understanding of testing concepts, methodologies and processes
* Knowledge and experience working with Docker
* Experience with C# / .NET environment
* Familiarity with .NET Aspire
* Practical knowledge of Azure DevOps (ADO) for managing CI/CD workflows and deployment pipelines
* Exposure to AWS services, with an interest in working within a modern cloud backend architecture
* Willing to participate in and often lead technical discussion(s)
* Ability to learn and/or adapt quickly to highly complex issues
* Happy to collaborate with a wide group of stakeholders
* Experience contributing to user stories and acceptance criteria
* Seeks opportunities to improve themselves and focuses on personal development
* Has a general attitude of care and responsibility towards their work
* Basic understanding of practical networking concepts (TCP/IP) and containerised environments

Trayport is committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide accommodations for applicants and employees who require it.

  

### **About Us**

**Our Culture:**
================

At Trayport, our people power our success. We are a place where talented people never stop learning, innovating and working together to make an impact!  
  
We offer you more than a job - we offer you the opportunity to work with, and learn from the most respected industry and thought leaders in the business. We’re always pushing the boundaries, rapidly expanding our global presence across London, Vienna, Singapore, Bremen and North America.  
  
At Trayport, we understand that our people are crucial to our future. We strive to provide a challenging and inspirational atmosphere; employing intelligent, enthusiastic, adaptable individuals and giving them the  
freedom, training, and guidance to allow them to consistently achieve their potential.  
  
If you share our vision and are motivated to challenge the status quo - we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and highly skilled Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic technology team. In this role, you will drive the development and enhancement of innovative software applications, ensuring seamless integration between front-end interfaces and back-end systems. Your expertise will empower us to deliver robust, scalable, and user-friendly solutions that meet the evolving needs of our users. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across diverse technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and grow your technical skill set in a collaborative environment.

**Duties**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications utilizing languages such as JavaScript, Java, C#, Python, Ruby on Rails, C++, C, and C# to create efficient and reliable solutions.
* Implement responsive front-end features with modern frameworks and libraries to enhance user experience across devices.
* Develop and optimize server-side logic, APIs, and database interactions using SQL, MySQL, and other relational databases.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, plan development cycles, and deliver high-quality software on schedule.

* Utilize Linux environments for deployment and maintenance tasks while leveraging tools like VBA for automation when appropriate.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in full-stack software development with a strong portfolio of completed projects.
* Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript along with front-end development frameworks such as React or Angular is highly desirable.

* Familiarity with database management systems like MySQL or SQL Server is essential for designing efficient data models.

* Knowledge of version control systems including Git and SVN for collaborative development workflows.

Join us as a Full Stack Developer if you’re passionate about crafting innovative software solutions that make a difference! Bring your technical expertise into a vibrant environment where your contributions directly impact our success—empowering users worldwide through cutting-edge technology!

Pay: £33,752.29-£89,745.10 per year

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

High performance isn't a given. It’s built on standards.  
Standards that have driven McLaren for over 60 years.  
And if you’re ready for the challenge, that standard is yours to own.  
Burning enthusiasm. Constant improvement. The thrill in the pursuit of better.  
That’s how we build a legacy. And how you build a career here.  
Because racing isn’t just something we do. It’s who we are.  
We are racers.  
Are you?

 **Job Description**

Join the dual-series software team supporting McLaren’s Hypercar and IndyCar teams. You will help develop and support high-quality, bespoke software tools that enable our engineering teams to analyse data, improve performance and deliver results on track.

This is an opportunity to contribute to two events within the Triple Crown of Motorsport: the Indianapolis 500-Mile Race and the 24 Heures du Mans. You will work within a close-knit team where everyone takes accountability, continuously improves and plays a vital role in our on-track success.

Principal Accountabilities

* Contribute to the development of bespoke software solutions used to analyse data, improve performance and deliver results on track.
* Work across multiple projects involving a wide range of programming languages, technologies and data formats.
* Participate in the complete software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, specification, architecture and design, development, deployment, maintenance and support.
* Support the software and tools produced by the team, collaborating daily with engineers across the IndyCar and Hypercar engineering organisations.
* Respond to support queries and alerts, check monitoring and systems, and help maintain the smooth day-to-day operation of the team.
* Contribute to stand-up, retrospective and planning meetings.
* Continue developing your professional skills and identify new tools and technologies that could benefit the team.
* Provide event support across different time zones, including frequent out-of-hours and weekend working.
* Occasionally provide trackside support and travel internationally.
* Take on additional responsibilities suited to your skills when required to help the team go racing.

  
**Qualifications**  

* At least two years of commercial experience applying software engineering in a practical environment.
* Motorsport experience or equivalent experience within a fast-paced, high-performance environment, such as the military, games or aerospace industries, real-time systems or a similar setting.
* A strong theoretical understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns and principles, data structures and algorithms, relational and NoSQL databases, and test-driven development.
* A BSc in Computer Science or a relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* High proficiency in at least one common programming language used in a commercial environment, such as C# or Python.
* Some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Kubernetes is preferred.
* The adaptability to work with different technologies according to engineering requirements.
* A collaborative, small-team mentality and the determination to deliver high-quality work on time.
* The ability to work effectively with engineers and technicians from a range of disciplines.

The team is based at the McLaren Technology Centre in Woking and operates a flexible hybrid model, with regular office-based collaboration.

 **Additional Information**

Success in racing comes from bringing together talented people with different skills, perspectives and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels supported and empowered to deliver their best work.

Every role has the potential to drive high performance. You'll be part of a team united by a shared ambition to push boundaries and embody our racing mindset. We invest in our people through opportunities to develop and grow, creating an environment where individuals and teams can thrive.  
  
Alongside a range of wellbeing initiatives and development opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding career and make your mark at McLaren Racing.

jobs.title: DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:

* Engineer and maintain AI application infrastructure, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), containers, and cloud-native services.

jobs.title: Senior Power System Engineer
jobs.description:
Team

**Engineering**

Business Unit

**Electricity Transmission**

Requisition No.

**11041**

City

**Warwick, GB, CV34 6DA**

Date posted

**30 September 2026**

**Senior Power System Engineer**
================================

National Grid is hiring a Senior Power System Engineer - This position is based from our Warwick office however we offer flexible hybrid working options.

You will develop into a highly capable transmission planning engineer, building expertise in strategic network assessment, system modelling, and Net Zero network development while contributing to some of the most significant transmission investment decisions in Great Britain.

### **Job Purpose**

As a Senior Power System Engineer within the Net Zero Engineering team, you will lead the technical assessment of future electricity transmission network requirements to support the decarbonisation of Great Britain's energy system. You will play a key role in identifying network needs, assessing system capability, developing innovative solutions, and providing robust engineering evidence to inform major transmission investment decisions.

Working across National Grid Electricity Transmission, NESO, customers, regulators, and industry stakeholders, you will lead strategic studies that support long-term network development, enabling the integration of renewable generation, large-scale demand growth, electrification, and emerging technologies.

You will combine advanced power system engineering expertise, modelling, analytics, and strategic thinking to ensure the future network can deliver Net Zero outcomes safely, efficiently, and economically.

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead strategic network planning studies to identify future transmission system needs and reinforcement requirements.
* Lead boundary capability assessments and transfer capability studies to assess future network constraints and opportunities.
* Develop technical recommendations to support transmission investment decisions and business cases.
* Assess the impact of generation, storage, demand growth, data centres, hydrogen, electrification, and emerging technologies on transmission system capability.
* Develop, model and evaluate innovative network solutions, including topology optimisation, flexibility services, HVDC, FACTS, and other system-wide interventions.
* Translate complex technical analysis into clear strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Lead development of modelling methodologies, analytical tools, and data-driven approaches to network planning.
* Provide technical leadership for innovation projects relating to future network operation and Net Zero delivery.
* Build strong relationships across National Grid, NESO, Ofgem, customers, and wider industry organisations.
* Mentor and coach engineers, supporting capability development across the team.
* Champion engineering excellence, governance, and compliance with industry standards and licence obligations.

### **About You**

**Essential**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in transmission planning, strategic network planning, system studies, or power system analysis.
* Strong understanding of:
* Power system analysis and modelling.
* Transmission planning methodologies.
* Boundary capability and transfer assessments.
* Network investment appraisal and cost-benefit assessment.
* Future energy scenarios and system planning processes.
* Strong working knowledge of:
  + NETS SQSS
  + Grid Code
  + CUSC
  + Relevant transmission planning standards

* Experience using power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD, or equivalent.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**

* Experience in tCSNP, ETYS, NOA, SSEP, CSNP, or similar network planning processes.
* Experience in Python, DPL, optimisation techniques, data analytics, or automation.
* Knowledge of probabilistic assessment techniques and Monte Carlo analysis.
* Understanding of HVDC, FACTS, power electronics-dominated networks, and system operability challenges.
* Chartered Engineer status or working towards Chartered status.

### **What You'll Get**

A competitive salary dependent on capability

Plus Market Suppliemnt Annual £4,500

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

The closing date for this vacancy is 14th October. However, we encourage candidates to submit their applications as early as possible and not to wait until the published closing date. National Grid’s recruitment periods can and may vary. We reserve the right to remove this advert or close it to further applications at any point during the recruitment process.

In NGET we are passionate about both operating our network safely and providing highly reliable quality of supply for our customers. At the heart of achieving these outcomes is the effective control and operation of our network.

To find out more , please follow the link below:

https://www.nationalgrid.com/electricity-transmission/

DE & I statement

At National Grid, we work towards the highest standards in everything we do, including how we support, value and develop our people. Our aim is to encourage and support employees to thrive and be the best they can be. We celebrate the difference people can bring into our organisation, and welcome and encourage applicants with diverse experiences and backgrounds, and offer flexible and tailored support, at home and in the office.

Our goal is to drive, develop and operate our business in a way that results in a more inclusive culture. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, the innovation from diverse teams & perspectives and business need. We are committed to building a workforce so we can represent the communities we serve and have a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

jobs.title: IT Developer Graduate Programme
jobs.description:
* **Location(s):**
* Swindon, Wiltshire, GB, SN5 6PB

**RWE Supply & Trading GmbH**

**Start date:** September 2027  
**Salary:** starting at £41,000 p.a

Are you looking to kickstart your career at a company where you can truly make an impact? Whether we’re delivering power to millions, trading in new markets around the globe, or driving the rapid growth of renewable energy, RWE is at the forefront of the industry. But we wouldn’t be there without world-class IT.

  

**About the role**

The IT Developer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who want to build a career in software engineering and application development, placing you at the heart of our commercial business.

Through a series of hands-on technical rotations, you’ll work closely with analysts and business support teams to deliver solutions for our energy trading and commercial operations teams, while developing expertise in programming, cloud-native technologies and DevOps practices.

Along the way, you’ll broaden your technical stack and business knowledge, gain experience across a range of programming languages and working environments, and build an understanding of different teams and cultures, providing a strong foundation for your permanent role and long-term career development.

You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:

* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.

Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:

* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages - C#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.
* Fluent English.
  

**From here, you’ll have a community of support**

While you’re on our graduate journey, we’re committed to providing you with a range of opportunities to grow and develop your skills. Alongside job rotations and technical training, you’ll be provided with comprehensive behavioural skills training with our expert partner, Cappfinity. This will enable you to harness your strengths from day one and identify new ways to utilise the key Skills That Build Skills. This will support you to reach your potential and goals, shaping your career path. The behavioural skills training is immersive, including interactive sessions where you can learn from our facilitators and your own peers, and self-led elements to support your application of learning back in your day-to-day role.

Our graduate programmes have been designed to give you the chance to shape your own career path and personal development, with the support you need to succeed. You’ll have access to a graduate buddy and a senior mentor within your field who can advise you on rotations and introduce you to key people within the business.

RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you.

  

**Your benefits**

At RWE, we’ll do everything we can to support you in fulfilling your potential. Our benefits include:

* Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus.
* Company pension and discounted employee share scheme.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days.
* Two paid annual volunteer days for a charity or initiative of your choice.
* International rotations with financial support for relocation.
* Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity support.
* Free on-site healthcare and access to AXA Private Healthcare Scheme.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential support for work, health, or life matters.
* Access to modern offices, state-of-the-art IT and diverse employee networks.
* Flexible benefits, including retail discounts.

Find out more on rwe.com/graduates

  

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too.
  
  
We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmatters

The IT Developer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who want to build a career in software engineering and application development, placing you at the heart of our commercial business.

Through a series of hands-on technical rotations, you’ll work closely with analysts and business support teams to deliver solutions for our energy trading and commercial operations teams, while developing expertise in programming, cloud-native technologies and DevOps practices.

Along the way, you’ll broaden your technical stack and business knowledge, gain experience across a range of programming languages and working environments, and build an understanding of different teams and cultures, providing a strong foundation for your permanent role and long-term career development.

You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:

* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.

Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:

* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages - C#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.
* Fluent English.
  

**From here, you’ll have a community of support**

While you’re on our graduate journey, we’re committed to providing you with a range of opportunities to grow and develop your skills. Alongside job rotations and technical training, you’ll be provided with comprehensive behavioural skills training with our expert partner, Cappfinity. This will enable you to harness your strengths from day one and identify new ways to utilise the key Skills That Build Skills. This will support you to reach your potential and goals, shaping your career path. The behavioural skills training is immersive, including interactive sessions where you can learn from our facilitators and your own peers, and self-led elements to support your application of learning back in your day-to-day role.

Our graduate programmes have been designed to give you the chance to shape your own career path and personal development, with the support you need to succeed. You’ll have access to a graduate buddy and a senior mentor within your field who can advise you on rotations and introduce you to key people within the business.

RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you.

  

**Your benefits**

At RWE, we’ll do everything we can to support you in fulfilling your potential. Our benefits include:

* Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus.
* Company pension and discounted employee share scheme.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days.

* Flexible benefits, including retail discounts.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmatters

* Ability to learn and to meet deadlines.
