jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Booking Engine
jobs.description:
#### **About Tripstack**

Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.

Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API.

Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.

Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.

For more information, visit:

www.tripstack.com

www.etraveligroup.com

#### **The Role**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Booking Engine organization. You will own the technical direction of systems at the core of our product - pricing, availability and booking flows that serve millions of requests per day. Beyond writing code, you will set architectural direction, unblock others, and represent the team's technical position to product and to peer engineering groups.

This role suits someone who is a natural problem solver, detail-oriented, and comfortable moving between deep individual contribution and technical leadership in a fast-paced environment.

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope. We do not have a separate formal tech lead title.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Set and drive the technical direction for one or more Booking Engine services - make architecture decisions, document the trade-offs, and act as the technical point of contact in planning, prioritization and dependency discussions
* Design, write, review, test and support C#/.NET code for reliable, high-quality systems at scale serving millions of requests per day
* Break large initiatives into deliverable increments - design solutions, get them reviewed, create stories, deliver and maintain
* Own latency, availability and cost characteristics of your services, and keep them within the reliability targets the organization sets
* Maintain and evolve our gRPC-based API 2.0 alongside the .NET services it fronts, keeping the two in step as the API surface changes
* Proactively identify technology opportunities for the company, and push technical ideas, proposals and plans to the entire organization
* Work cross-functionally with product managers, client integration teams and other engineering groups to deliver high-quality products and improve internal KPIs
* Coordinate and monitor regular releases to production
* Participate in the on-call support rotation, lead the team through incidents impacting live systems, and drive follow-up actions to completion
* Raise the engineering bar, mentor engineers through interactive code review, design review and knowledge-sharing sessions, and help the team make good use of AI-assisted development tooling

#### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related technical field experience

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (PHP+React)
jobs.description:
**About SINGU**

At **SINGU**, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become **Europe’s leading platform** for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

**Our unified CAFM platform** already powers the daily operations of **over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide**, supporting more than **500,000 professionals.** Following our union with the UK’s **Micad** and Germany’s **net-haus,** we now help manage **100,000+ buildings** across **35+ countries** — and we’re just getting started.

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as **Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood,** **Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield.** As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: **adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.**

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — **join SINGU and be part of this transformation.**

**About SINGU**

SINGU is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in Europe. Our platform manages over **200 million sqm** of commercial real estate for **500+ clients in 35 countries**, helping property managers digitalize and automate their operations.

**About the Team**

The **TAM (Technical Account Management) team** delivers **customizations, dedicated functionality and system integrations** for our largest enterprise clients - international leaders such as Prologis, P3, CTP and AmRest.

A significant part of the work is **data imports/exports and integrations with external systems** (ERP, HR, finance, SSO), where **security, data correctness and database performance** are critical. Customizations must fit into a shared, multi-tenant product - so design quality matters as much as delivery speed.

**Tech Stack**

* **Backend:** PHP 8 (Phalcon), REST APIs, Redis, background job queues
* **Database:** PostgreSQL
* **Frontend:** React (TypeScript)
* **Tooling:** Git (Git Flow), Docker, CI/CD, PHPUnit, PHPStan
* **AI-assisted development:** Claude / Cursor / Copilot are part of our daily workflow

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must-have**

* **5+ years of commercial PHP** backend development (7.4+/8)
* **Expert PostgreSQL** - query optimization, indexing, execution plans, migrations on large datasets
* Proven experience designing and maintaining **REST APIs**
* Hands-on experience with **data import pipelines** and **external system integrations** (files, APIs, queues) - idempotency, validation, error handling, reprocessing
* **Working React knowledge** - you can deliver a feature end-to-end when needed, not only read the code
* Strong focus on **security** (secure coding, access control, data protection) and **performance** of high-volume operations
* **Full ownership** of delivered solutions - from technical design to production and support
* Experience **mentoring** other developers and doing meaningful code reviews
* You actively use **AI tools** (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT) in your daily work
* **Communicative English (B2+)** - technical specs, tickets, documentation; occasional calls with client technical teams
* **Fluent Polish** - the team works in Polish internally

**Nice to Have**

* Phalcon framework
* PostgreSQL tuning (partitioning, vacuum, planner) and performance troubleshooting in production
* ERP / enterprise integrations (SAP, Dynamics, PeopleSoft), SSO (SAML / OIDC)
* Docker, AWS, CI/CD
* Customization-heavy or multi-tenant B2B SaaS background
* Improving test automation and local development environments

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and implement **integrations and custom functionality** for enterprise clients
* Build **secure, high-performance backend services** in PHP, and extend React frontends when the feature needs it
* Design and optimize **data import/export processes** with focus on security, data integrity and performance
* Find and remove performance bottlenecks in application and database layers
* Take part in **technical breakdown and estimation** before development starts; co-own API contracts
* Review code and **mentor mid-level developers**; be a go-to person for backend and database topics
* Collaborate with the Tech Lead, QA, and other SINGU teams (Platform, Core)

**Why This Role**

* Real integrations with enterprise systems - not toy projects
* Direct impact on systems used daily by some of the largest companies in Europe
* Senior influence: your technical opinion shapes how the team builds
* A team that values clean code, security and performance

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Compensation Range: PLN 18K - PLN 22K

jobs.title: Middle .NET Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Software Engineer** to join a dedicated team working on high-impact, enterprise-scale software solutions for public sector funding and financial management systems.

The candidate will work within a large-scale ecosystem comprising core transactional systems, reporting tools, and public application portals. You will play a key role in developing new features, integrating modern microservices, refactoring legacy components, and migrating services to modern technologies (.NET 6/8, modern web frameworks).

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Systems Analysis & Architecture:** Analyze requirements, extract business logic from legacy systems, and create modeling/visualization artifacts using UML standards.
* **Full-Stack Development:** Design, maintain, and expand back-end services and front-end portals using C#/.NET, REST APIs, and modern UI tools.
* **Legacy Refactoring & Decoupling:** Write anti-corruption layers and seams to safely isolate legacy code from new, modern application components.
* **Data Access & Databases:** Design and optimize database access structures using MSSQL, Entity Framework Core (Code-First), and the repository pattern.
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:** Create decoupled unit tests, write feature documentation, and conduct end-to-end (E2E) testing on newly built features.
* **Agile Collaboration:** Participate in daily stand-ups and Agile/Scrum ceremonies, managing code, documentation, and tasks via Azure DevOps.

### **Requirements**

**Education & Experience:**

* **Bachelor's Degree** in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (MQF Level 6 or equivalent).
* **3+ years of professional experience** in software development and systems analysis.
* Practical experience working in Agile/Scrum environments using tools like Azure DevOps.

**Technical Skills:**

* **Back-End & Frameworks:** Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 6/8, ASP.NET MVC, REST APIs, and Entity Framework Core.
* **Front-End Development:** Experience with HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, OpenXML, and modern web frameworks (Angular, React, or Blazor).
* **Databases:** Strong knowledge and practical experience with MSSQL, Entity Framework (Code-First), and repository patterns.
* **Architecture & Clean Code:** Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), writing decoupled unit tests, and designing anti-corruption layers.
* **Version Control & DevTools:** Hands-on experience with Git/Azure Repositories and Browser Development Tools (DevTools).

**We offer\*:**

* Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location-specific benefits

* not applicable for freelancers

jobs.title: Liferay Technical Architect
jobs.description:
#### **Who We Are**

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Lead to build a B2B eCommerce platform for a leading pharmaceutical brand, and to lead the engineers building it alongside you.

This is a coding role first. You'll spend most of your week in the codebase, setting the technical standard by writing the hardest parts yourself and reviewing everything else. You'll work to the architecture set by our Technical Architect and turn it into working software, leading a distributed engineering team and working alongside WPP's managed service team who run and support the platform in Liferay.

**What you'll be doing**

* Write production code. Liferay customisation, backend services and integrations, with the complex and high-risk work landing on your keyboard
* Lead a distributed engineering team day to day, owning technical delivery through the sprint
* Run code review and set the quality bar in the codebase, through standards, testing and pairing rather than documents
* Break the architecture down into buildable work, and challenge the design where implementation reality says it won't hold
* Own the build and release pipeline, environments and branching strategy
* Debug and fix the problems nobody else can, across Liferay, integrations and infrastructure
* Make sure what you build can be run, monitored and supported by a managed service team at agreed service levels
* Support technical service transition, including runbooks, operational acceptance criteria and monitoring requirements
* Act as technical escalation for the managed service team on complex incidents and root cause analysis
* Own the technical debt backlog in the codebase and get remediation into the sprint, not just onto a list
* Work directly with product owners, QA and the client's technical team at working level, in refinement, demos and technical clarification

**What we want from you**

* Strong hands-on Java engineering. You're coding now and you want to stay that way
* Proven Liferay DXP development experience. OSGi modules, Service Builder or client extensions, headless and REST APIs, fragments and workflow
* Commerce experience, on Liferay Commerce or a comparable platform. Catalogues, pricing, channels, carts and order flow
* Solid integration engineering. REST, messaging, enterprise integration patterns and error handling in anger
* Confident with relational databases, query performance and data modelling
* Practical cloud experience, and CI/CD pipelines you've built and maintained yourself
* Experience leading engineers through code review, pairing and technical direction rather than line management
* Experience building solutions that are handed into, or run by, a managed service or application support team
* Observability, logging, monitoring and alerting treated as part of the build
* Clear written and spoken English, and technical documentation other engineers can actually use
* Comfortable in a distributed, multi-location team across UK and India

**If you know some of this, even better**

* Liferay certification, or contribution to the Liferay community
* Experience delivering into validated or regulated environments. GxP, CSV or data residency
* Event-driven architecture and streaming platforms
* Caching strategies at scale, at Liferay and CDN layer
* Elasticsearch or OpenSearch tuning
* Prior experience of a blended change and run model

You will collaborate with our UK project team, so we'll need you to be available until 18:00 PL

### **What we can offer you**

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we'll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We'll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.  
  
We offer net hourly rate for **B2B** cooperation ranging from **159 - 206 PLN**, dependent on your skills and experience.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with **Heart**, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.  
We empower your **Brains** for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.  
And we champion **Courage**, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

Learn more about us on our LinkedIn page, visit our YouTube channel and follow us on Instagram WPP Poland.

  

*Please note that this job is a full-time position located in Poland, but the selection process will be conducted in English.*

*Please send over your CV in English.*

  

***How we use AI in the recruitment process:***  
  
*To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we* *leverage* *AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective* *note-taking**, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time.* *Opting out will not* *impact the* *outcome of the interview process*

In compliance with Polish regulations, VML Enterprise Solutions is committed to fostering a transparent and ethical work environment. We encourage reporting of any potential irregularities or misconduct. For detailed information on our whistle-blower policy and reporting procedures, please refer to our dedicated document.

**At WPP** **Enterprise Solutions**
-----------------------------------

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernisation, connecting strategy directly to execution.

Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX, work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. We have received distinction as a leader in Commerce Services and CX Strategy Consulting by the Forrester Wave™

To find out more, visit enterprisesolutions.wpp.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

WPP Enterprise Solutions is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

jobs.description:

Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Altium 365 for cloud lets design engineers communicate, collaborate and bring their ideas to market more efficiently than any platform in the industry. These are some of the R&D Software Engineering contributions you might make to Altium 365:

* Building new cloud-native applications and scalable infrastructure
* Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
* Large-scale data processing; data modeling; holistic, intent-based API design
* Stateful and stateless services, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, your primary focus will be developing complex cloud applications as part of the Altium 365 R&D team.

* Work with Java, AWS, multi-tenant architecture, and distributed high-load systems.
* Solve technical challenges at the intersection of engineering software, electronics, and cloud services.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineers to deliver reliable, scalable features.
* In a team, contribute to technical decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Share knowledge and help strengthen the team’s engineering practices.

* You are proactive, self-motivated, and committed to continuous learning.
* You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and are open to different perspectives.
* You think beyond the immediate solution and anticipate problems early in development.
* You adapt well to changing priorities and requirements.
* You take ownership of commitments and see work through to completion.

**Required Technology Experience**

* Experience designing and developing backend services and APIs.
* Experience with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, and RDS.
* Understanding of microservices and multi-tenant architectures.
* Experience with relational databases, preferably MySQL.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Experience working with distributed systems and production cloud environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with .NET
* Experience modernizing or integrating complex enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of high-load systems, performance optimization, or cloud observability.
* Experience with Firebird database.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

In this role, you will work closely with development teams, business stakeholders, and Global IT to define solution designs, align technical decisions, and ensure our applications remain maintainable, scalable, and ready for future challenges.

jobs.title: Enterprise AI Architect
jobs.description:
#### **Enterprise AI Architect**

**Format:** project for an international client; a three-engineer team (Architect + 2 Lead AI Solutions Engineers). Technical lead of the AI capability.

#### **About the Role**

We are looking for an Enterprise AI Architect to define the technical shape of the entire AI capability on the engagement: standards, shared components, and the evaluation and release strategy. You will work directly with the client's leadership (CTO, enterprise architects, senior business stakeholders), select platforms and approaches, and defend those decisions in front of both technical and business audiences. You stay hands-on throughout: you write and review code and personally own the quality of what reaches users.

#### **What You Will Do**

**Shape the work**

* Work with senior business stakeholders and domain experts to establish objectives, constraints, and expected outcomes.
* Identify which processes are worth automating and which are not, and say so plainly, including when the answer is no.
* Select the right tools, platforms, and approaches for each business problem and justify the choice.
* Shape and present solution proposals: scope, approach, effort, expected impact. Presales is part of the job.
* Own outcomes with a product mindset: adoption, measurable time saved, and the reliability of what real users experience.

**Build it**

* Design, build, test, and maintain reusable AI skills: instructions, supporting scripts, validation logic, reference data, shared components.
* Write and review production-quality code, owning it through review, CI, and release.
* Build the evaluation layer: golden cases, acceptance criteria, regression checks.
* Debug agent behaviour: establish why a workflow produced the wrong result and fix the root cause.
* Integrate with the client's platforms and data sources.

**Drive it forward**

* Run pilots with real consultants, collect structured feedback, and ship improved versions.
* Set and enforce standards for how skills are authored, reviewed, versioned, and released.
* Track where AI tooling is heading and bring the relevant parts into the engagement before the client asks.
* Provide technical leadership to two engineers: review, direction, unblocking.

#### **What We Expect**

**Architecture and engineering**

* Proven architectural ownership of real systems: module boundaries, reuse, versioning, integration, non-functional constraints.
* Still hands-on: you build, review, test, and maintain production-quality solutions personally. This is not a role for pure managers or "PowerPoint architects".
* Strong engineering foundation in at least one modern stack. Our delivery stack is TypeScript / Node.js (NestJS, Angular); fluency is an advantage, not an entry condition. A strong architect from a Python, Java, or .NET background who is fluent in modern AI tooling is a great fit.
* Standard professional practice: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD.

**AI engineering**

* Hands-on experience with modern AI tools and platforms, and a working map of the current landscape rather than familiarity with a single vendor.
* Real LLM-backed systems shipped to real users, not prototypes.
* Working command of agentic patterns: tool use / function calling, MCP, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured instruction design, orchestration.
* Sound judgement about applicability: which business problems fit which technique, and where the honest answer is conventional software.
* Experience evaluating and improving non-deterministic systems: test sets, measurable acceptance criteria, iteration driven by results rather than intuition.

**Architect-specific**

* Make and justify platform-level decisions: agent harnesses, integration architecture, build-versus-adopt.
* Define and enforce what a well-formed skill looks like, what belongs in shared infrastructure, and what gets rejected in review.
* Data handling, security, and compliance judgement when working with a client's sensitive HR and compensation data.
* Credible in the room with a client's CTO, enterprise architects, and senior business leadership.

**Consulting and communication**

* Able to explain a technical approach and its trade-offs to a non-technical audience and be understood.
* Presales capability: shaping solutions, scoping, estimating, and presenting to decision-makers.
* Able to turn ambiguous business requirements and tacit domain knowledge into a clear design and an executable workflow.
* Comfortable operating without a specification and asking the questions that close the gap.
* English at C1: you run client conversations unaided.
* Sustained working-hours overlap with the client (US / Western Europe).

#### **Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Claude Code, particularly authoring Claude Code Skills, plugins, or MCP servers.
* Experience with LLM evaluation tooling (promptfoo, LangSmith, custom harnesses).
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Domain exposure to HR technology, compensation & benefits, payroll, or workforce analytics.
* Experience building internal developer tooling or standing up a platform capability.
* Public artefacts: open-source agent tooling, published skills or plugins, conference talks, technical writing on agentic engineering.  
    
  **What we offer**

  + Model: B2B contract with Bonapolia - one contract, one monthly invoice
  + Rate: negotiated per candidate seniority and client budget
  + Payment: monthly invoice, paid on the same schedule the client pays us (usually 30 days)
  + Contract written under your country's law
  + We handle the client-side paperwork: MSA, NDA, invoicing

  **About Bonapolia**

  Bonapolia is a family-owned IT staff augmentation team based in Lisbon. We build engineering teams for product companies and IT consultancies across Europe and the US.

  More at bonapolia.com  
    
  **Ready to Join?**  
  We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our team!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Senior ServiceNow Developer)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Sopra Steria** is one of the largest players in the tech industry in Europe, known for its consulting, digital services and software development. We operate in nearly 30 countries in the world, hiring more than 55,000 employees.  
The Polish branch, as the Global Delivery Center, operates in Katowice since 2007 and has been growing ever since. Currently, our team consists of around 1,000 specialists.

Within the Digital Platform Services department, our teams specialize in areas such as cloud, operating systems, virtualization, databases, backup or storage, as well as networking and security. We also have 1st line support consultants who speak French and English, but also Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German.

The Application Services department is responsible for areas such as software development, data engineering, testing services, CRM, ITSM and ERP platform integrations, as well as application management for customers in Scandinavia, Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland and the UK.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer (Senior ServiceNow Developer)** to join the **Sopra Steria Polska** team and contribute to the projects for our clients.  
  
**Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who are located in Poland and have EU citizenship.**  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Participate in ServiceNow implementation, enhancement, and optimization projects.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Design, configure, and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform, primarily within the ITSM module.
* Develop and maintain workflows, integrations, catalog items, business rules, script includes, and other custom platform components.
* Implement new functionalities and enhancements in accordance with business and technical requirements.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term solutions.
* Review, optimize, and refactor custom code to ensure performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow best practices.
* Support platform upgrades, patches, and releases, including testing and validation activities.
* Monitor and maintain integrations and APIs to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for configurations, integrations, and custom developments.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, consultants, and Agile teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Recommend and implement continuous improvements to enhance platform functionality, performance, and user experience.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**We are looking for someone with:**

* Solid hands-on ServiceNow development experience, ideally around 4–5 years.
* Good knowledge of ITSM and the ServiceNow platform in general.
* Practical experience with CMDB, CI classes, relationships and data imports.
* Experience with REST integrations, IntegrationHub, Import Sets/Transform Maps and scripting.
* Good ServiceNow scripting skills: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, GlideRecord, Flow Designer, etc.
* Understanding of data modelling and ability to translate functional/data requirements into ServiceNow configurations.
* Ability to analyse existing solutions, troubleshoot issues and independently implement moderate-complexity changes.
* Experience with upgrades, maintenance and day-to-day evolution of ServiceNow ITSM processes.
* Experience with Discovery, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, Security Operations or ServiceNow instance consolidation would be an advantage, but is not required.

**Additional must Have Requirements:**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Fluent English B2/C1.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Proactive and detail-oriented.
* Ability to document processes and share knowledge effectively.
* Being open to occasional business trips abroad and visits in our office in Katowice.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

What we offer:

* BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus,[copyrights, life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten.
* DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES (B2B): Tech Lunches, Worksmile, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud).

ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation.  
In case of questions, please contact the HR team.

The recruitment process for this position consists of two stages:  

* a short phone call with a recruiter (30 min max)
* one-hour long interview on Teams (with both general and technical questions)

**Salary range:**  
  
UOP: 12 000 -16 000 PLN gross/month;  
B2B: 100-140 PLN/h net + vat.

All information about salary range and its additional components will be provided during the 1st stage of recruitment process.

At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – C#.net and APL
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer – C#.net and APL**

  

**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a top provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

  

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide high-quality solutions to our clients

  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

  

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

  

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Transactions & Private Debt product area and contribute to business-critical functionality used by our clients in their daily investment operations.

  

You will work as part of an experienced engineering team, contributing to backend development, component design, performance, reliability and maintainability. The work is technically interesting because it combines complex business logic, long-lived enterprise software and the need to keep improving how we build and deliver functionality.

  

Most of the current product logic is written in APL, while we are increasing our use of C#/.NET and AI in new development, integrations, cloud enablement, and platform modernization. You do not need prior APL experience. We will provide training and support and we are looking for someone who is curious enough to learn what is needed while bringing solid engineering practices from C#/.NET.

  

You will work with experienced engineers across locations and have room to contribute to how we build, modernize and evolve the product.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help the team build reliable, maintainable and well-tested backend solutions. In practice, you will:

Design, implement, test and maintain backend functionality using APL and, where relevant, C#/.NET

Contribute to component design, code quality, performance and long-term maintainability

Work closely with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver client-relevant functionality

Improve reliability and delivery through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering practices

Investigate technical issues, performance bottlenecks and bugs and help design sustainable solutions

Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to technical discussions within the team

Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment.

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, mathematics, or a related field.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving
* Solid experience in C#/.NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations).
* Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e.g., service bus patterns).
* Experience with Azure or cloud-based development is an advantage, but not a prerequisite
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows.
* Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to work with complex business logic and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues .

**APL READINESS**

You don’t need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant.  

  

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* FinTech / regulated-industry experience.
* Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL).
* Experience with Azure services or cloud-based development.
Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a component.  

  
  

**BENEFITS**

* Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
* Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
* Base salary with annual bonus structure
* Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
* Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)
* Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)
* Multisport card with 75% employer contribution
* Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available)
* Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance
* Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
* Copyrights program for certain roles
* Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
* Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
* Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs  

  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Tangella Viswanath, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Location/Division Specific Information:**

**Olink**, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.

**Job description:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Data Engineer** with knowledge of AWS to contribute to the development of our internal data and analytics platform. The platform support our R&D organisation with advanced analysis tooling and data processing. In the role as Data Engineer, you will be part of a team focusing both on the core part of the platform and data ingestion pipelines as well as contributing to the development of advanced analysis tools and automations in cross functional initiatives. You will work and closely collaborate with our AI analysis team and software development team. This role is based in our Uppsala office.

  

**A Day in the Life:**

* Implement a robust and scalable environment in AWS using best practices whenever applicable.
* Design and develop robust data pipelines for ingestion and transformations
* Model and design for optimized data processing performance, ensuring efficient use of resources and adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, providing technical guidance and support to team members and stakeholders
* Contribute with up-to-date industry standards, trends, and advancements in the data engineering field, applying new techniques and technologies as appropriate.

**Requirements and skills:**
----------------------------

* Master of Science in Molecular Biotechnology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role.
* Experienced working in AWS.
* Familiarity with data modelling, data warehousing, and big data technologies.
* Strong programming skills in Python or C# is desired.
* Background in the biotech industry is beneficial.
* Knowledge of Databricks is beneficial.
* Very good English and Swedish language skills.

**Why Join Us?**

At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

The final date for submitting applications is on the 22th of October. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

*Vill du arbeta med modern .NET-utveckling i ett område som driver framtidens finansiella tjänster? Området bygger på möjligheten att på ett säkert och reglerat sätt dela finansiell information och tjänster mellan banker och tredjepartsleverantörer.*

Vi söker en .NET-utvecklare till vårt Open Banking-team, där du får utveckla moderna backendlösningar och API:er som möjliggör säker och smidig integration mellan banker, fintechbolag och andra aktörer.  
  
Open Banking ingår i affärsområde Kund och Vardagsbank så det är en spännande portfölj att arbeta i där det händer mycket.

**Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare**  
Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av Skandiabankens Open Banking-team, där du utvecklar lösningar som möjliggör säker och smidig integration mellan banker, fintechbolag och andra externa aktörer. Open Banking är ett område som förändrar hur finansiella tjänster skapas, används och delas, och som öppnar upp för nya innovationer och bättre kundupplevelser.

Du kommer främst att arbeta med backendutveckling. I takt med att regelverken utvecklas och möjligheterna att dela finansiell information växer också Open Banking-området. Det innebär att du får vara med och bygga nästa generations lösningar, där nyutveckling, innovation och teknisk utveckling står i fokus.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* utveckla och vidareutveckla backendlösningar i .NET

* utveckla och förvalta API och integrationer

* bidra till tekniska lösningar

* arbeta med nyutveckling i takt med att området och regelverken utvecklas

* tillsammans med teamet bidra till säkra, stabila och hållbara lösningar

**För att lyckas i rollen**

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av backendutveckling inom .NET och C#. Du har god förståelse för integrationer och hur olika system kommunicerar med varandra.

Vi ser att du har:

* flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C#/.NET

* erfarenhet av att utveckla och arbeta med API

* erfarenhet av systemintegrationer

* goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Erfarenhet från Open Banking, finansiella tjänster eller andra reglerade verksamheter är meriterande.

**Vem är du?**

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad utvecklare som tycker om att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska sammanhang. Du trivs med att samarbeta, dela kunskap och tillsammans med teamet hitta hållbara lösningar.

Du är också nyfiken på ny teknik och motiveras av att arbeta inom ett område som utvecklas i takt med både teknik, kundbehov och nya regelverk.

**Vad händer nu?**

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.
  
  
Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Monika Olsén på monika.olsen@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation
jobs.description:
**Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation**
===========================================================

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring a Software Test Engineer to own software verification for a Class III medical device system spanning embedded firmware, desktop applications and the communication between them. This is a verification role in the regulatory sense: you will derive test cases from approved software requirements, demonstrate objectively that the software meets them, and produce the traceable, auditable evidence that supports the design history file and technical documentation.

You will also develop and maintain the automation that makes verification repeatable. Using a Python-based test framework integrated with CI/CD, you will help turn regression testing from extensive manual work into reliable pipeline-driven execution.

You will analyse software requirements and design specifications for testability, ambiguity and measurable acceptance criteria. You will create verification plans, protocols and test cases, select and justify suitable verification methods, define expected results and pass/fail criteria, and maintain traceability from requirement through execution record to result.

The role also includes executing protocols under configuration control, documenting objective evidence, managing deviations and amendments, investigating defects, and writing verification reports. You will contribute to design reviews and audits by clearly explaining and defending the verification approach.

On the automation side, you will design, build and maintain test frameworks and automated suites across unit, integration and system levels. This includes developing test harnesses, simulators, stubs and fixtures, as well as supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing where appropriate. You will integrate suites into GitHub Actions and help ensure that automated results can serve as reliable verification evidence.

**About You**
-------------

You have experience of working with software testing in a regulated environment and understand the importance of disciplined design control, configuration management and technical documentation. You are comfortable moving between detailed test work and the broader verification argument, and you can distinguish between requirement, implementation and test defects.

To succeed in the role, you combine a rigorous, structured approach with practical engineering judgement. You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating closely with software, firmware, systems and QA/RA colleagues to keep requirements, code and tests aligned.

**What we Offer**
-----------------

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of verification in a complex medical device environment and to contribute to both the verification process and the automation infrastructure that supports it. You will work across embedded firmware, desktop applications and connected interfaces, with a clear opportunity to influence templates, tooling and workflows as verification needs evolve. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.

**Application**
---------------

We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from **18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026.**

For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64. Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience of software testing in medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
* Understanding of formal design control or safety lifecycles, including the distinction between design verification and design validation.
* Demonstrated experience of requirements-driven test design, including defining objective acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability, and producing verification protocols and reports suitable for audit.
* Experience of building and maintaining automated test suites, including framework design, test data management and test fixtures.
* Experience of version control, change control and formal defect management.
* Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
* Strong spoken and written English.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, computer science or a closely related technical field; equivalent demonstrable experience is also valued.
* Working familiarity with .NET/C# and C++, including the ability to read code, understand architecture and create meaningful integration tests.
* Practical Python experience for test automation, using a framework such as pytest, unittest or Robot Framework.
* CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, including workflow YAML, runners, matrices, secrets, caching and artifacts.
* Experience of IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, including software safety classification, testing expectations, SOUP management and anomaly evaluation.
* Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR technical documentation and IEC 62366 usability engineering.
* Experience of ALM or requirements-management tools such as Polarion, Jama, Codebeamer, DOORS or Azure DevOps, including generating trace matrices.
* Experience of embedded or hardware-adjacent testing, for example serial protocols, CAN bus, instrument control, logic analysers, test rigs or hardware-in-the-loop frameworks.
* Experience of static analysis, code coverage measurement and their role in software verification.
* Experience of FDA inspections, notified body audits, or regulatory submissions such as 510(k), PMA or CE submissions.
* Exposure to cybersecurity testing for connected medical devices.

**About Scandinavian Real Heart**
---------------------------------

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?

Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many  
patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution.

Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team  
placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

jobs.title: Performance Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Performance Test Engineer (Azure)

Short-term, Part-time contract

10 – 15 hours per week

**About us**
============

Sleep.ai is an AI-powered sleep platform on a mission to change the world through the power of sleep. We help companies build sleep insights, coaching and research-backed solutions into their products and services, and we power consumer products such as the SleepScore app. We have offices in San Diego, Dublin and Berlin.

We are seeing growing traction and interest, and the number of users joining our platform is climbing quickly. Our platform runs on Azure, using Function Apps, Storage Queues, Blob Storage and Table Storage. We need to understand where it will struggle as load grows, and what needs to change so it can scale.

**Learn more:** www.sleep.ai

**The role**
============

We are looking for an experienced Performance Test Engineer to assess the scalability, stability and responsiveness of our platform under varying load. You will identify bottlenecks, carry out root cause analysis and give us a clear, prioritised plan to resolve them.

You will lead the performance testing effort, working in close collaboration with our backend and DevOps teams to agree priorities, shape the approach and review findings. You will recommend appropriate tooling, with selections reviewed and approved by the engineering team to ensure they fit our platform and existing practices.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

* Define a performance testing strategy and test plans in collaboration with the backend and DevOps teams, covering load, stress, spike, soak/endurance and scalability scenarios
* Establish performance baselines and capacity limits for the current platform
* Build realistic user-journey and message-volume scenarios and execute them using load testing tools reviewed and approved by the engineering team (for example k6, JMeter, Gatling, Azure Load Testing or similar)
* Analyse Function App behaviour: cold starts, scale-out limits, concurrency settings and hosting plan suitability
* Analyse queue behaviour: throughput, backlog growth, poison messages, retry patterns and processing lag
* Analyse Blob and Table Storage behaviour: throttling, partition design, hot partitions, storage account scalability targets and latency under load
* Use observability and monitoring tooling (for example Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or similar) to trace requests, correlate metrics and pinpoint root causes
* Produce clear performance reports with findings, risks and prioritised recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Recommend fixes and, where agreed, help implement them, then re-test to confirm the improvement
* Define SLOs, regression thresholds and quality gates that can be built into our CI/CD pipeline

**Essential skills and experience**
===================================

* Proven experience as a Performance Test Engineer or Performance Engineer (typically 5+ years)
* Hands-on experience with performance testing tools (for example k6, JMeter, Gatling, NeoLoad or similar)
* Strong background in bottleneck analysis and troubleshooting on cloud-hosted distributed systems
* Solid working knowledge of Azure serverless and storage services: Functions, Storage Queues, Blob Storage and Table Storage
* Experience with APM and observability tooling (for example Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace or similar)
* Able to script in a language suited to the task (for example C#, JavaScript, Python or similar)
* Strong written communication skills, with the initiative to lead the work and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and DevOps teams

**Desirable**
=============

* Experience with cloud-based load testing services and CI/CD pipelines (for example Azure Load Testing, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar)
* Familiarity with messaging and data services that could form part of a future scale-up path (for example Service Bus, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Durable Functions or similar)
* Previous experience working with startups or scale-ups

**Engagement**
==============

**Type:** Contract, part-time

**Hours:** 10–15 hours per week

**Duration:** initial term, e.g. 8–12 weeks, with option to extend

**Location:** remote / hybrid, Ireland-based preferred

**Rate:** €35 – €50/Hour

**Reporting to:** Head of Quality Assurance

**Expected deliverables**
=========================

* A baseline performance report for the current platform
* A bottleneck and risk register, ranked by impact
* A scaling roadmap with recommended changes and effort estimates
* A reusable load test suite, ready to run in our pipeline

**You will:**

Vacancy Number: 28643

Category: Engineering - Project Management

Job Type: Full-time

**Position Description**

  

Asset Development is tasked with identifying, developing and constructing new investment opportunities on behalf of ESB Group. Asset Development activities comprise identifying and developing opportunities to enhance our portfolio to realise our Brighter Future strategy. The opportunities are managed through development and construction to commercial operation. The Flexible Technology Development unit within Asset Development has successfully developed flexible generation, battery and synchronous compensator projects in the last two years.

EirGrid and ESB Networks are developing market competitions for building long duration energy storage (LDES) projects. Flexible Technology Development is responsible for developing a pipeline of generation and LDES projects and system support technologies (eg synchronous compensation), along with opportunities for flexible generation assets to meet market requirements.

The successful candidates will support the Project Director on assigned project development activities such as establishing techno-commercial feasibility of projects, landowner engagement, overseeing planning activities and project design. The role will involve working closely with team members across the various business units in ESB including engineering, planning and legal specialists.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Support project teams in assessing and developing opportunities, including greenfield and brownfield sites, new technologies and acquisitions.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders to secure permits, authorisations, planning and connection agreements.

* Support preparation of projects for market competitions, including storage, capacity and system services.
* Research technology areas with commercial potential.
* Manage procurement and contract strategy, and coordinate project contracts.
* Support delivery of Safe and Sound across all projects.

Manager Flexible Technologies, Asset Development.

* Access Credit Union membership, a generous pension and staff well-being programmes.
* Benefit from generous parental leave entitlements and supports that recognise life outside work.
* Join an organisation with a strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

€59,980 - €70,564 per annum

15th October 2026

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

  

* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive

* Respectful and Supportive
  

More information available on Our People Promise

Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.

jobs.title: Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)
jobs.description:
### **Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)**

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Due to the 24/7 nature of our support organization, certain events throughout the year will require volunteering for coverage outside one's normal work days or work hours (i.e. regional offsites, regional holidays, etc). These are typically announced weeks in advance with a sign-up system that considers equitability.

### **Cool things you'll do**

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

### **What you need**

We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas

* Systems administration
* Distributed systems
* Network Administration
* Database architecture and administration
* Application Architecture
* Data architecture and design
* Performance tuning and benchmarking
* Extra bonus points if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).

It's crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes

* 2- 3 years of specific engineering experience in technical engineering
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Genuine desire to help people
* Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
* Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Company**

The Irish Times Group is Ireland's leading independent quality news publishing organisation, owned by The Irish Times Trust and managed by The Irish Times DAC, evolving from a six-day print publisher into a seven-day, multi-platform media group encompassing titles such as The Irish Times, Irish Examiner, The Echo, regional newspapers, The GLOSS Magazine, and digital platforms including MyHome.ie and RIP.ie, reaching millions of readers across Ireland and internationally.

**The Role**

We are seeking mid-level Test Automation Engineers to build and scale our test automation capability as part of our strategic development capacity expansion. These roles are critical to enabling our growing development teams to deliver features faster whilst maintaining the quality standards our readers expect.

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for our web applications and mobile apps. You'll work collaboratively with developers, QA, and product teams to establish automation frameworks and practices that scale with our growing engineering organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications and mobile apps (iOS/Android)
* Write clear, maintainable, and efficient test code following software engineering best practices
* Implement end-to-end, integration, and regression tests across our publishing platform
* Build reusable test components and frameworks to accelerate automation coverage
* Debug and troubleshoot test failures, distinguishing product issues from test infrastructure problems

**CI/CD Integration**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous feedback
* Configure test execution environments and manage test data
* Monitor test execution and maintain test suite health
* Optimise test execution time and reliability
* Integrate Reporting and Monitoring tools.

**Collaboration & Quality**

* Work closely with developers to understand features and identify automation opportunities
* Collaborate with QA team to prioritise automation backlog based on business impact
* Participate in code reviews for both production and test code
* Contribute to defining and improving testing standards and practices
* Document automation frameworks, patterns, and processes

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify areas where automation can improve velocity and quality
* Evaluate and recommend testing tools and technologies
* Refactor and maintain existing test suites to prevent technical debt
* Share knowledge and mentor team members on automation practices

**Requirements & Experience**

**Core Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript required, with demonstrable experience in modern frameworks and tools.
* Experience with additional languages (Python, Java, C#).
* 2-4 years experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress (web), Appium, Detox, XCUITest, BrowserStack, or REST Assured, Postman (API)
* Experience working with Test Management and Agile Methodologies.
* Solid experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
* Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipeline, or similar)
* Strong understanding of testing principles, test design patterns, and best practices

**Professional Experience**

* 2-4 years in software testing with focus on test automation
* Proven track record of building and maintaining automated test suites in production environments
* Experience working in agile development teams
* Demonstrable ability to write clean, maintainable code

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Good communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences
* Collaborative mindset - comfortable working across development, QA, and product teams
* Self-motivated with ability to work independently and prioritise effectively
* Attention to detail whilst maintaining focus on business impact

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with multiple testing frameworks and ability to evaluate trade-offs
* Knowledge of performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6)
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Knowledge of database testing and SQL
* Experience in digital media, publishing, or content management systems is nice to have
* Understanding of web performance optimisation and SEO considerations
* Mobile app testing experience across iOS and Android platforms

**Application Process**

Please apply with your CV through the Apply button below.

The Irish Times Group operates a Hybrid working policy and is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Our benefits include Health Insurance contribution, Pension Contribution, Sick Leave Cover, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Irish Times Premium Digital Subscription, Income Protection Policy, Corporate Gym Membership discounts, Free Digital GP and Life Assurance Policy.

**IT Developer – Private Equity Technology (Dublin)**

**About Citco**

Armed with superior services, smart people, and strong technology, we tackle our customers’ complicated challenges by developing sophisticated solutions driven directly by their demands. The result? Innovation that generates tangible value and makes a real difference for our clients and their companies.

**About the Team & Business Line**

Proprietary software solutions and innovation are at the core of what differentiates Citco in the alternative investment space. Through our network of global development centres, Citco invests heavily in technology development, security, and infrastructure to ensure our clients continue to receive award-winning products that underpin our commitment to service excellence.

Private Equity IT develops and supports strategic applications across fund accounting, reporting, workflow automation, data integration, cloud services and financial calculations. Our teams work across multiple products and projects, providing broad business and technical exposure while delivering the reliability, scalability and security expected of enterprise financial systems.

We are looking for a software engineer who combines strong technical foundations with an enthusiasm to learn and contribute to architecture, software development, technical design and production support while delivering exceptional value to our Private Equity business partners.

Our engineers work across multiple products, technologies and initiatives supporting Citco's Private Equity business. This provides excellent opportunities to develop technical breadth while gaining exposure to real-world financial systems operating at global scale.

The position is based in our development center in Dublin and may require some international travel to other CITCO locations.

**About You** **:**

* You are an enthusiastic software engineer with approximately 2+ years of software development experience who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies and working collaboratively as part of a high-performing engineering team. You are curious about emerging technologies, including AI-assisted software development, and are committed to continuously improving your technical and professional skills while delivering quality solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in the design, development, testing and support of enterprise software solutions.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, QA engineers and product stakeholders to deliver business value.
* Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions while learning from more experienced engineers.
* Assist with troubleshooting production issues and identifying opportunities for system improvements.
* Utilize modern software engineering tools and practices to improve development efficiency and software quality.
* Contribute to the documentation of solutions, technical designs and operational processes.

**Required Skills**

* 2+ years of professional hands-on experience participating in the design, development, testing and support of software applications.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm for continuous learning and staying current with evolving software engineering practices, tools and technologies
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, AWS Q, Kiro or equivalent tools to improve productivity, software quality and delivery outcomes.
* Understanding of the importance of validating and testing AI-generated code before deployment.
* Interest in emerging technologies including LLMs, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Appreciation of software security, privacy and responsible AI practices.
* Understanding of object-oriented design principles and software engineering best practices.
* Familiarity with automated testing approaches including unit and integration testing.
* Experience working with source control systems such as Git / Bitbucket.
* Ability to design maintainable, readable and supportable code.
* Understanding of REST API design principles.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python, Node and / or C#
* Practical experience with React
* Experience with SQL Server, Postgres or similar DB technology

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, etc.)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in financial services is advantageous.
* Exposure to alternative investments, fund administration or accounting platforms is beneficial but not required.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfortable working collaboratively through code reviews, design discussions and knowledge sharing with other engineers.
* Demonstrates initiative, curiosity and a willingness to ask questions and learn.
* Able to receive and act on feedback constructively.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for assigned work.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within your first 12 months you will

  + Become a productive contributor within one or more Private Equity technology teams.
  + Deliver high-quality software enhancements through collaboration with senior engineers.
  + Demonstrate effective use of modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development technologies where appropriate.
  + Build a strong understanding of Citco's development practices, technology platforms and business domain.
  + Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud-native solutions.
  + Develop meaningful relationships with colleagues across development, QA, infrastructure and business teams.
  + Establish a reputation for quality, reliability, collaboration and continuous learning.
