* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions in a timely manner.
* Act as a technical enabler for development teams, providing tooling, guidance, and support across environments. Champion DevOps best practices and empower teams to take ownership of their delivery pipelines

**Who We Are**
--------------

Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960's. We're Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. Malaga is our newest tech hub where we are building one of the leading software engineering teams in Spain.

We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands.

You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers!

**What we offer**
-----------------

Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with over 1,000 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you're a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you'll fit right in.

  

* 25 working days of paid vacation.
* Private health and life insurance.
* Flexible compensation package for transport, meals, and more!
* Hybrid work policy for the best of office and home.

* Office perks to make your day easier.
* Referral program with a bonus for successful hires.

In addition to all of this, you will be part of the multi-cultural Betsson community enjoying team-building events, our Friday bars, our social clubs, parties and other events. There is always something fun to look forward to!

  

**Challenge accepted?**

jobs.title: Construction Safety Engineer
jobs.location: Navalmoral de la Mata, EX, ES
jobs.description:
### **General information**

Job Title

Construction Safety Engineer

Ref #

P1008824

Employment Type

Permanent

Department

Construction

Position level

Engineer

Date

Wednesday, September 23, 2026

AESC Office Location

Navalmoral de la Mata, Extremadura, Spain

### **Description & Requirements**

Job Description

**Company Overview**
--------------------

AESC is a global leader in lithium‑ion and LFP battery technology, with a fast‑growing footprint across Japan, the UK, France, China, and the USA. It is now expanding in Spain with a €1‑billion gigafactory in Extremadura that will create up to 900 direct jobs in phase one. The Spanish facility is designed as the first net‑zero industrial park gigafactory in the country, in line with AESC’s mission to pioneer sustainable battery manufacturing.

**Role Purpose**
----------------

The **Construction Safety Engineer** will lead Health & Safety management during the construction and installation of AESC’s battery gigafactory in Navalmoral de la Mata. The role sits within the Global Infrastructure & Construction (GIC) team, reports to the Construction Manager and acts as the Owner’s H&S representative on site. **The Engineer will make sure that contractors, suppliers and the Project Management Company (PMC) apply H&S requirements in line with Spanish legislation, project standards and AESC’s requirements.** The work is **on site, focused on execution, coordination and control**. It involves close collaboration with the legally appointed Health & Safety Coordinator (CSS), the PMC and Corporate EHS.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Project set-up**

* Translate AESC Corporate EHS policies and standards into project-specific H&S requirements for construction and installation activities.
* Define H&S requirements for contractors and suppliers, together with GIC and Corporate EHS.
* Align H&S planning with the PMC and the legally appointed Health & Safety Coordinator.
* Act as the Owner’s H&S representative with the competent authorities when required.

**Construction & installation**

* Lead on-site H&S supervision and coordination on behalf of GIC.
* Review contractors’ H&S documentation (Construction H&S Plans, RAMS, JSAs) and monitor how it is applied in the field.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable law, contractual requirements and the approved H&S documentation, including the coordination of business activities (CAE) and subcontracting control.
* Coordinate daily with the Construction and Site Management teams so that H&S is built into execution planning.
* Focus on the high-risk activities typical of a battery plant build: heavy lifting, electrical works and energisation, hot works, work at height, confined spaces, and interfaces between contractors and equipment suppliers.
* Carry out site inspections, audits and safety walks, and escalate deviations through GIC project channels.
* Coordinate corrective actions with contractors, the PMC and the CSS, and follow them through to closure.
* Support incident investigations and make sure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Report H&S performance, KPIs and critical risks to Project Management and Corporate EHS.
* Escalate critical risks and recommend stopping work through project governance channels when there is serious or imminent danger.

**Close-out & handover**

* Make sure that the construction H&S documentation and deliverables required for handover are complete and compliant.
* Work with Corporate EHS to align with commissioning and operational H&S requirements.
* Support final inspections, audits and regulatory reviews related to construction safety.
  

  

Led by a diverse and experienced management team, AESC employs more than 14,000 professionals worldwide. The company combines state-of-the-art technology, Japanese craftsmanship and a strong track record in safety to deliver advanced battery solutions. AESC offers a comprehensive portfolio across various cathode chemistries and form factors, including LFP, NCM/MCA, and pouch, cylindrical and prismatic cell formats.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Don’t you want to be part of this cutting-edge and revolutionary company?

#LI-SD1

Requirements / Required skills

* Environment, Health, and Safety
* Health & Safety
* Occupational Safety and Health Administration Training
* Contractor Safety

Qualifications

**Desired Requirements**
------------------------

  
  

* Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Building Engineering or a related technical field.
* Técnico Superior en Prevención de Riesgos Laborales covering the three specialities (Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Ergonomics & Applied Psychosociology). Mandatory.
* At least 5 years of H&S experience in large industrial construction projects, or at least 2 large industrial construction projects, with direct exposure to site execution, contractor management and multi-interface environments.
* Proven experience coordinating H&S on construction sites. The Coordinador de Seguridad y Salud qualification is highly valued.
* Proven experience supervising EPC/PMC contractors on multi-contractor sites with complex interfaces.
* Hands-on experience supervising high-risk activities: lifting operations, electrical works, hot works, work at height and confined spaces.
* Solid knowledge of Spanish H&S legislation, especially construction regulations (RD 1627/1997, RD 171/2004, Ley 32/2006).
* Experience on the Owner/Client side, either directly or through a prevention service hired by the Owner, is a plus.
* Experience leading H&S on at least one large project is a plus.
* Experience on industrial, chemical or energy projects is valued, especially gigafactories or lithium battery plants, as is having followed a project through to commissioning and handover.
* Experience working with international (e.g., Chinese) contractors and installers is a plus.
* NEBOSH or an equivalent international H&S certification is a plus.
* Language Skills: Spanish – native or proficiency (mandatory); English – a plus.
* Based in Navalmoral de la Mata or within approximately 45 minutes by car, or willing to relocate. 100% on site.
* Strong leadership and authority on H&S matters, including the ability to stop work when needed, with excellent coordination and stakeholder-management skills, attention to detail, a proactive prevention mindset and the ability to perform under demanding project schedules.

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Nombre de vacante**

Cloud Operations Engineer

  

**Descripción**

We’re looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Barcelona and help run reliable, secure, and cost-efficient production platforms across a multi-cloud, multi-region, geo-distributed environment. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role supporting SaaS services and infrastructure that must remain highly available and performant around the clock.
  
  
You’ll work closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to support day-to-day operations, drive automation, strengthen observability, and reduce cloud waste through disciplined resource management. If you enjoy working across modern cloud platforms with real production responsibility and a bias toward operational excellence, this role is a strong fit.
  
  
This role includes participation in a 24/7 on-call rota.
  
This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week in our Barcelona office.
  
  
First 90 Days
  
30 Days: Get to grips with Sage’s cloud estate: the AWS and Azure environments, Kubernetes workloads, observability tooling, and the operational processes that keep production running. Familiarise yourself with runbooks, incident procedures, and the teams you’ll partner with. Begin contributing to day-to-day operations and shadow the on-call rota before joining it.
  
60 Days: Take active ownership of operational tasks across your assigned areas. Handle infrastructure maintenance, Kubernetes workload support, and incident response with growing confidence. Begin contributing to Terraform-based infrastructure work and automation initiatives. Engage with Engineering and Security colleagues on ongoing improvements to observability and platform reliability.
  
90 Days: Operate independently across the full scope of the role: multi-cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, IaC, scripting, monitoring, and incident response. Contribute meaningfully to cost efficiency initiatives, documentation, and the team’s continuous improvement agenda. Be a reliable, collaborative presence in a fast-paced global environment.
  
  
Meet the Team
  
You’ll join the Cloud Operations team – a hands-on engineering group responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of Sage’s production SaaS platforms across AWS and Azure. The team operates across multiple regions and geographies, with a strong culture of automation, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You’ll work alongside Cloud Operations colleagues and partner closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams. The environment is fast-paced and production-focused – the kind of team that takes reliability seriously, values clear communication, and is always looking for ways to do things better.
  
  
How Success Will Be Measured
  
- Reliability and availability of the cloud infrastructure and services you support, measured against SLAs
  
- Speed and quality of incident response and service restoration
  
- Measurable reduction in cloud waste and improvement in cost efficiency across your areas
  
- Quality and coverage of operational documentation, runbooks, and support procedures
  
- Contribution to automation initiatives that reduce manual operational overhead
  
- Positive collaboration with Engineering, Security, and Product stakeholders

  

**Responsabilidades principales**

Qualifications
  
  
Essential
  
- 3+ years of experience in cloud operations, DevOps, SRE, systems engineering, or platform engineering
  
- Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, and working familiarity with the other platform
  
- Good understanding of cloud networking: VPCs/VNets, WAN, VPN tunnels and gateways, load balancers
  
- Kubernetes experience across deployment, operations, troubleshooting, and cluster support
  
- Experience with compute, storage, and platform services across cloud environments
  
- Infrastructure as Code experience, preferably with Terraform
  
- Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar
  
- Experience with observability and monitoring tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack, Zabbix, ADX, or Fabric
  
- A practical approach to cloud cost efficiency: eliminating waste, right-sizing resources, and promoting cost-aware operations
  
- Linux administration and troubleshooting experience
  
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, comfortable in a fast-paced global environment
  
  
Nice to Have
  
- Familiarity with Helm and Kubernetes release management
  
- Exposure to relational and non-relational databases
  
- Relevant cloud certifications: AWS SysOps Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent
  
  
Want to know more about our Product?: https://hcm.sage.com/
  
  
At Sage, we offer you an environment where you can grow professionally without compromising your personal well-being. Our benefits package is designed to provide stability, flexibility, and balance:
  
- Medical and dental insurance: Fully funded medical and dental insurance.
  
- Flexible benefits: Exchange part of your salary and make tax savings on meal and transport vouchers, childcare, and training.
  
- Well-being: Free access to the Calm app (for up to 5 users), 24/7 counselling, and emotional support from our Healthy Mind Coaches. We also offer self-care and parenting resources through the Cleo app.
  
- Flexible working: flexibility of working one hour in, one hour out, shortened workdays on Fridays and during the summer, and the opportunity to work from over 40 countries for up to 10 weeks per year through our Work Away program.
  
- Annual leave: 23 working days of vacation, 5 paid days per year for volunteering.
  
- Extended leave: 7 extra days of maternity leave and 5 extra days of paternity leave, on top of the legal allowance, available after one year of service.
  
- Financial support: Life and disability insurance, salary advances of up to 3.5 times your net monthly pay, a €300 net marriage bonus, and access to Sage's employee stock purchase plan at a discounted rate.
  
- Learning and development: Free premium subscription to external learning platforms
  
  
Health and Safety Responsibilities
  
- Fostering the safety culture, by leading with your own example.
  
- Following established safety procedures and reporting potential hazards promptly helps maintain a secure and efficient workplace.
  
- Participating in safety training sessions and adhering to preventive guidelines and procedures, the objective is minimizing risks and protecting yourself and the rest of your colleagues.
  
  
This role is not open to visa sponsorship. Candidates must have a valid work authorization for the location listed and not require sponsorship now, or in the future, for their application to be considered.
  
  
#LI-AL2

new_jobs.title: Senior DevOps engineer 1
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een DevOps engineer met passie voor CI/CD en automatisering? Bij de Belastingdienst in Apeldoorn werk je aan een toekomstbestendig software delivery platform voor Cobol én Java binnen het team Generieke Ondersteunende Services (GOS) van de afdeling Generieke Voorzieningen (GV). Een rol voor 36 uur per week.

* Bachelor-hbo
* 32-36 uur
* ICT
* € 4.132,- / € 6.275,- bruto p.m.
* Apeldoorn
  

* Reageer t/m 15 oktober 2026

**Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst**
-------------------------------------

Je werkt samen met jouw collega-ontwikkelaars in het DevOps-team aan het onderhouden en vernieuwen van het software delivery platform voor Cobol en Java binnen de Belastingdienst. Je onderzoekt bestaande oplossingen, beoordeelt hun nut en vertaalt de behoeften van ontwikkelaars naar praktische verbeteringen in tooling en automatisering. Denk aan het verbeteren van buildprocessen, codekwaliteit-controles en deployment flows. Daarmee optimaliseer je de voorzieningen achter het software delivery proces die door alle Cobol en Java engineers binnen de IV worden gebruikt.
  
  
Afhankelijk van jouw kennis en expertise kun je verdiepen op bijvoorbeeld Jenkins-pipelines op Linux. Of je werkt aan de implementatie van IBM DBB als nieuwe build-engine voor Cobol, of aan de implementatie van z/OS Connect waarmee REST API’s op het mainframe mogelijk worden. Keuze genoeg! Je krijgt volop ruimte om te experimenteren, verbeteren en vernieuwen in een Agile omgeving.

**Een bijzondere baan, omdat...**
---------------------------------

* je werkt aan een vernieuwend software delivery platform voor zowel Cobol als Java;
* je directe impact hebt op de kwaliteit en snelheid van softwareontwikkeling binnen de Belastingdienst;
* je volop ruimte krijgt om te experimenteren met nieuwe tools, technieken en werkwijzen;
* je samenwerkt met ervaren DevOps-collega’s in een Agile team met een duidelijke missie;
* je actief kennis deelt via presentaties, workshops en consultancy;
* je bijdraagt aan de modernisering van cruciale systemen met maatschappelijke relevantie.

* **De afdeling - Directie Informatievoorziening**
  ------------------------------------------------

  Toon inhoud van De afdeling - Directie Informatievoorziening

  De directie Informatievoorziening is hét ICT-bedrijf van de Belastingdienst. Met ruim 3.000 collega’s zorgen we dat Nederland kan rekenen op betrouwbare informatievoorzieningen en ICT-systemen. Heel Nederland? Ja, onze ‘klanten’ zijn niet alleen Belastingdienstmedewerkers, maar ook 8.600 grote ondernemers, 2,2 miljoen mkb-ondernemers en 8,5 miljoen burgers. En wist je dat wij werken volgens een agile-mindset? Open, transparant en gericht op leren en kennis delen. Door de toepassing van een DevOps-werkwijze en ons aanbod van geautomatiseerde technieken kunnen de systemen van de Belastingdienst dagelijks miljoenen data en euro’s verwerken.

  Bij ons werk je in een moderne tech-organisatie met ménsen als kloppend hart. Of je nu als engineer of in een andere rol bijdraagt aan effectieve ICT; jouw inzet doet ertoe. Net als jouw ontwikkeling, waarin wij graag investeren. En jouw ideeën, waar we graag naar luisteren. Ook is er volop ruimte om samen te innoveren met externe partijen. Niet alleen om te moderniseren, maar vooral om nieuwe producten en diensten te ontwikkelen die passen bij de belevingswereld van burgers, bedrijven en collega’s.

*“**Ik vind het geweldig om met mijn werk direct bij te dragen aan de vernieuwing van de CI/CD‑pipelines en het software‑voortbrengingsproces binnen de IV‑organisatie van de Belastingdienst.**” Jimmy, DevOps engineer*

**Wanneer past deze baan bij je?**
----------------------------------

* Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.
* Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring met het Linux-platform en met scriptingtalen zoals Groovy, Python of Ansible.
* Je hebt ervaring als lead DevOps engineer en het begeleiden van je collega’s.
* Je hebt kennis van CI/CD-processen en ervaring met het bouwen of verbeteren van Jenkins-pipelines.
* Je hebt ervaring met Agile werken, bijvoorbeeld binnen Scrum- of SAFe-teams en pakt ook daarin een actieve rol binnen het team.
* Je hebt gewerkt met testautomatiseringstools zoals Robot Framework of Python enkunt de behoeften van Cobol- en Java-ontwikkelaars vertalen naar praktische DevOps-oplossingen.

**Jouw competenties**
---------------------

* analyseren
* samenwerken
* resultaatgerichtheid
* plannen en organiseren
* zelfontwikkeling

**Meer over de vacature?**
--------------------------

### **Neem contact op met Ramses Pos, teamleider**

* Contact via Whatsapp: 06 - 15 67 50 34
* 06 - 15 67 50 34

**Solliciteren bij de Belastingdienst**
---------------------------------------

Het sollicitatietraject bij de Belastingdienst loopt via onderstaande stappen. Hiermee willen we zo veel mogelijk te weten komen over jou, maar laten we je ook kennismaken met ons.

1

### **Sollicitatie + selectie**

Solliciteren is mogelijk tot aan de deadline die in de vacaturetekst genoemd wordt. We beoordelen je cv en motivatiebrief op de genoemde functie-eisen.

2

### **Voorselectietest**

Voor sommige functies is een online voorselectietest onderdeel van de procedure. In dat geval ontvang je per e-mail meer informatie over de procedure en de uiterlijke inlevertermijn. Het maken van de test duurt ongeveer 120 minuten. De test kan in de meeste gevallen thuis worden gemaakt.

3

### **Sollicitatiegesprek**

We nodigen je per telefoon of e-mail uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek, waarin een selectiecommissie je beoordeelt op de competenties van de functie aan de hand van een competentiegericht gesprek.

4

### **Assessment**

Een assessment kan deel uitmaken van de procedure. In dat geval word je telefonisch of per e-mail hiervoor uitgenodigd.

5

### **Arbeidsvoorwaarden**

We nodigen je uit voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Na een positieve afronding, treffen we samen verdere voorbereidingen voor jouw eerste werkdag! Wil je alvast meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Op P-direkt vind je informatie over onderwerpen zoals financiën, vrije dagen, loopbaanontwikkeling, rechten en regels en nog veel meer.

* **Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden**
  ---------------------------

  Toon inhoud van Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden

  ### **Salarisniveau**

  Schaal 11

  ### **Salarisomschrijving**

  Individuele schaalInschaling vindt plaats in de bij de functie behorende salarisschaal. Elke salarisschaal kent 11 salarisnummers met bijbehorende maandbedragen; deze staan vermeld in de salaristabel op de website CAO Rijk. De inschaling vindt plaats op basis van relevante kennis en het aantal relevante werkervaringsjaren passend bij de uit te voeren werkzaamheden in de nieuwe functie.Als voorbeeld: met 3 jaar relevante werkervaring word je ingeschaald in nummer 3 van de betreffende salarisschaal.

  ### **Maandsalaris**

  Min €4.132,- - €6.275,- (bruto)

  ### **Dienstverband**

  Bepaalde tijd, voorafgaand aan onbepaalde tijd

  ### **Minimum aantal uren per week**

  32

  ### **Maximum aantal uren per week**

  36

  ### **Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden**

  Naast salaris ontvang je ook een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Jouw IKB bestaat uit geld (IKB-budget) en tijd (IKB-uren). Het IKB geeft je de mogelijkheid om naar eigen keuze een deel van je IKB-budget te laten uitbetalen op de door jou gekozen tijdstippen. Én je hebt de mogelijkheid om je IKB-budget deels om te zetten in verlof of andersom. Ook kun je het IKB-budget besteden aan een fiscaal-vriendelijk doel, zoals bijvoorbeeld een fiets, bedrijfsfitness of vakliteratuur.

  De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer studiefaciliteiten, ouderschapsverlof en een vergoeding woon-werkverkeer.

  Wij verwachten van onze werknemers dat ze integer zijn en we vragen aan nieuwe medewerkers een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Als deze niet kan worden overlegd voor de indiensttreding, volgt geen arbeidsovereenkomst.
* **Bijzonderheden - Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!**
  -----------------------------------------------------

  Toon inhoud van Bijzonderheden - Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!

  We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee.

  Onze selectieprocedure voor deze functie ziet er als volgt uit:

  + Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor deze functie.
  + Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie-eisen.

  Onderaan deze vacature vind je meer uitleg over de stappen die je doorloopt in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel de genoemde kennis en werkervaring als op het opleidingsniveau. Vermeld deze daarom duidelijk in je cv.

  De Belastingdienst zet zich in voor de banenafspraak: zoveel mogelijk banen realiseren voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking. Val jij in deze doelgroep? Wij zullen je ondersteunen zodat je optimaal kunt functioneren, en daarmee jouw bijdrage aan Nederland kunt leveren. Of het nu gaat om aanpassingen op je werkplek, bepaalde voorzieningen in het vervoer of bijvoorbeeld vergoedingen van het UWV: samen met jou, je leidinggevende én een jobcoach gaan wij kijken naar jouw kwaliteiten en mogelijkheden om een passend werkpakket uit te voeren. Wil jij weten of je hierbij hoort en wat dit exact betekent voor jou?

  Een (online) voorselectietest en/of een assessment kan deel uit maken van de sollicitatieprocedure, evenals het maken van een casus, het opvragen van referenties en (online) screening, bijvoorbeeld via databanken, (zoekmachines) en sociale netwerken.

  Jouw sollicitatie wordt alleen in behandeling genomen als je met de sollicitatie-button reageert en je cv en motivatiebrief zijn bijgesloten. Na sluitingsdatum is het niet meer mogelijk om je sollicitatie in behandeling te nemen. Houd er rekening mee dat het solliciteren technische problemen met zich mee kan brengen. Wacht hiermee dus niet tot het laatste moment.

De taak van de Belastingdienst is om wetgeving correct uit te voeren. Maar welke gegevens moeten op basis van welke wet worden verwerkt? En sluiten databases nog aan op wat wetgeving en de organisatie vragen? Dit zijn precies de vraagstukken waar jij je als data engineer dagelijks mee bezighoudt.

* Bachelor-hbo
* 32-36 uur
* ICT
* € 4.132,- / € 6.275,- bruto p.m.
* Apeldoorn
  

* Reageer t/m 22 oktober 2026

**Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst**
-------------------------------------

Als data engineer binnen Datateam Metis duik je in complexe, jarenlang gegroeide systemen en maak je de logica daarachter inzichtelijk. Je haalt informatie uit ruwe en ongestructureerde data en herkent patronen die helpen het datalandschap beter inzichtelijk en beheersbaar te maken.

Je vertaalt wetgeving en beleid naar conceptuele, logische en fysieke gegevensmodellen. Daarnaast bouw en onderhoud je datapipelines die hierop aansluiten. Je zorgt dat gegevensmodellen, databases en dataplatformen consistent blijven, waarbij datamodellering de basis vormt van je werk.

Je werkt binnen Datateam Metis samen met een data architect, kennismodelleur, gegevensmodelleurs en een databasebeheerder. Ook werk je veel samen met architecten, productowners en softwareontwikkelaars binnen het kennisgebied Loonheffingen.

**Een bijzondere baan, omdat...**
---------------------------------

* je werkt aan gegevens die essentieel zijn voor de uitvoering van belastingwetten in Nederland
* je verborgen logica in complexe systemen zichtbaar maakt en daarmee blijvende oplossingen realiseert
* je wetgeving, beleid en techniek samenbrengt in gegevensmodellen die de basis vormen voor informatievoorziening
* je werkt in een klein team waarin intensief wordt samengewerkt en kennis wordt gedeeld
* je veel ruimte krijgt voor ontwikkeling, eigen inbreng en het werken met nieuwe technologieën
* je gebruik kunt maken van flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken

* **De afdeling - Directie Informatievoorziening**
  ------------------------------------------------

  Toon inhoud van De afdeling - Directie Informatievoorziening

  De directie Informatievoorziening is hét ICT-bedrijf van de Belastingdienst. Met ruim 3.000 collega’s zorgen we dat Nederland kan rekenen op betrouwbare informatievoorzieningen en ICT-systemen. Heel Nederland? Ja, onze ‘klanten’ zijn niet alleen Belastingdienstmedewerkers, maar ook 8.600 grote ondernemers, 2,2 miljoen mkb-ondernemers en 8,5 miljoen burgers. En wist je dat wij werken volgens een agile-mindset? Open, transparant en gericht op leren en kennis delen. Door de toepassing van een DevOps-werkwijze en ons aanbod van geautomatiseerde technieken kunnen de systemen van de Belastingdienst dagelijks miljoenen data en euro’s verwerken.

  Bij ons werk je in een moderne tech-organisatie met ménsen als kloppend hart. Of je nu als engineer of in een andere rol bijdraagt aan effectieve ICT; jouw inzet doet ertoe. Net als jouw ontwikkeling, waarin wij graag investeren. En jouw ideeën, waar we graag naar luisteren. Ook is er volop ruimte om samen te innoveren met externe partijen. Niet alleen om te moderniseren, maar vooral om nieuwe producten en diensten te ontwikkelen die passen bij de belevingswereld van burgers, bedrijven en collega’s.

*“Elke dag komt er een vloedgolf aan gegevens binnen en elke wet stelt andere eisen aan de verwerking daarvan. Welke data hoort bij welke wet? Klopt het model nog met de werkelijkheid? Dat uitzoeken is precies waar ik energie van krijg. Ik vind het belangrijk om niet alleen te weten dát iets werkt, maar ook waarom.”* *Data engineer*

**Wanneer past deze baan bij je?**
----------------------------------

* Je werkt en denkt op hbo- of wo-niveau.
* Je hebt grondige kennis van conceptueel, logisch en fysiek gegevensmodelleren en werkt met methoden zoals ER en UML.
* Je hebt ervaring met standaarden zoals NL SBB, MIM en TOGAF of ArchiMate.
* Je hebt ervaring met modelleertools zoals BizzDesign Enterprise Studio, PowerDesigner of vergelijkbare software.
* Je werkt met relationele databases, schrijft complexe SQL-query's en legt verbanden tussen gegevens en processen.
* Je bouwt en onderhoudt ETL- en ELT-processen, datapipelines en dataoplossingen. Daarnaast heb je kennis van datawarehouses, data lakes en moderne dataplatformen. Ervaring met Python en cloudomgevingen zoals OpenShift is een pré.

**Jouw competenties**
---------------------

* analyseren
* samenwerken
* mondelinge uitdrukkingsvaardigheid
* initiatief
* creativiteit

**Meer over de vacature?**
--------------------------

### **Neem contact op met Erik Hamelers, teamleider**

* Contact via Whatsapp: 06 - 11 49 92 02
* 06 - 11 49 92 02

**Solliciteren bij de Belastingdienst**
---------------------------------------

Het sollicitatietraject bij de Belastingdienst loopt via onderstaande stappen. Hiermee willen we zo veel mogelijk te weten komen over jou, maar laten we je ook kennismaken met ons.

1

### **Sollicitatie + selectie**

Solliciteren is mogelijk tot aan de deadline die in de vacaturetekst genoemd wordt. We beoordelen je cv en motivatiebrief op de genoemde functie-eisen.

2

### **Voorselectietest**

Voor sommige functies is een online voorselectietest onderdeel van de procedure. In dat geval ontvang je per e-mail meer informatie over de procedure en de uiterlijke inlevertermijn. Het maken van de test duurt ongeveer 120 minuten. De test kan in de meeste gevallen thuis worden gemaakt.

3

### **Sollicitatiegesprek**

We nodigen je per telefoon of e-mail uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek, waarin een selectiecommissie je beoordeelt op de competenties van de functie aan de hand van een competentiegericht gesprek.

4

### **Assessment**

Een assessment kan deel uitmaken van de procedure. In dat geval word je telefonisch of per e-mail hiervoor uitgenodigd.

5

### **Arbeidsvoorwaarden**

We nodigen je uit voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Na een positieve afronding, treffen we samen verdere voorbereidingen voor jouw eerste werkdag! Wil je alvast meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Op P-direkt vind je informatie over onderwerpen zoals financiën, vrije dagen, loopbaanontwikkeling, rechten en regels en nog veel meer.

* **Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden**
  ---------------------------

  Toon inhoud van Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden

  ### **Salarisniveau**

  Schaal 11

  ### **Salarisomschrijving**

  Inschaling vindt plaats in de bij de functie behorende salarisschaal. Elke salarisschaal kent 11 salarisnummers met bijbehorende maandbedragen; deze staan vermeld in de salaristabel op de website CAO Rijk. De inschaling vindt plaats op basis van relevante kennis en het aantal relevante werkervaringsjaren passend bij de uit te voeren werkzaamheden in de nieuwe functie.Als voorbeeld: met 3 jaar relevante werkervaring word je ingeschaald in nummer 3 van de betreffende salarisschaal.

  ### **Maandsalaris**

  Min €4.132,- - €6.275,- (bruto)

  ### **Dienstverband**

  Onbepaalde tijd

  ### **Minimum aantal uren per week**

  32

  ### **Maximum aantal uren per week**

  36

  ### **Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden**

  Naast salaris ontvang je ook een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Jouw IKB bestaat uit geld (IKB-budget) en tijd (IKB-uren). Het IKB geeft je de mogelijkheid om naar eigen keuze een deel van je IKB-budget te laten uitbetalen op de door jou gekozen tijdstippen. Én je hebt de mogelijkheid om je IKB-budget deels om te zetten in verlof of andersom. Ook kun je het IKB-budget besteden aan een fiscaal-vriendelijk doel, zoals bijvoorbeeld een fiets, bedrijfsfitness of vakliteratuur.

  De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer studiefaciliteiten, ouderschapsverlof en een vergoeding woon-werkverkeer.

  Wij verwachten van onze werknemers dat ze integer zijn en we vragen aan nieuwe medewerkers een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Als deze niet kan worden overlegd voor de indiensttreding, volgt geen arbeidsovereenkomst.
* **Bijzonderheden - Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!**
  -----------------------------------------------------

  Toon inhoud van Bijzonderheden - Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!

  We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee.

new_jobs.title: Civil Engineer (Development)
new_jobs.description:
**Civils Engineer (Development)**

**Location** - Prenton offices, Wirral (with site visits across SP Manweb)

**Salary + benefits** - £45,400 - £56,750 with annual review, comprehensive pension scheme (company doubles your contribution up to 10%), plus extensive benefits package

**Closing date** - Monday 26th October

  
  

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

  

Our industry is experiencing unprecedented transformation as we work towards Net Zero. SP Energy Networks is delivering multiple projects simultaneously, overhauling our network to enhance resilience and secure electricity supply for our communities' economic growth. As a Civils Engineer (Development), you will play a vital role in this transformation by undertaking site inspections of substation construction projects from 11kV to 33kV. You will ensure works are carried out according to approved construction plans, SPEN building specifications, and best practice standards. Using your professional judgement and technical expertise, you will provide design and construction guidance to internal Design functions and external Framework Contractors. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on critical infrastructure that powers communities across the North West of England.

  
  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Conduct regular inspections of building work at various stages of completion, measuring and sampling building materials to verify their quality meets required standards
* Confirm that construction work aligns with approved plans and SPEN specifications, while providing technical design assistance to SPM Design, customer engagement teams, and other teams during project design phases
* Become well-versed in the SPEN Civil specification for Primary Substation Civil works, reviewing end-of-project returns including as-built documentation to ensure civil works are properly recorded within SPEN corporate systems
* Review financial applications made via framework arrangements to ensure they align with works delivered on site
* Maintain quality and consistency of technical and construction output across all projects
* Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders and customers on behalf of ScottishPower, facilitating delivery of strategic goals
* Promote an exemplary safety culture, ensuring all safety legislation is implemented and delivered through activities and incorporated into project designs
* Contribute to team development by mentoring and training less experienced team members, graduates, and trainees, helping to build capability across the organization
* Manage a 6-month work bank of site inspections in coordination with design teams, overseeing civil works for Primary Projects in the delivery phase up to and including 33kV, typically valued at approximately £25m per annum
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* NVQ, HND, or bachelor's qualification in a construction-related subject such as building surveying, civil engineering, structural engineering, or construction management
* Membership of a relevant professional body such as the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), the Chartered Association of Building Engineers (CABE), or the Chartered Institute of Building (CIOB) is highly valued
* Solid knowledge of structural and civil engineering design approaches and material properties
* Practical familiarity with construction methods and experience across common forms of construction
* Capability to interpret construction drawings with meticulous attention to detail
* Knowledge of building regulations, construction processes, legislation, and requirements
* 5 years or more of relevant experience, with great attention to detail and pride in design quality
* Full clean driving licence (required)
* Experience working in the electrical industry is desirable though not essential
* Strong numeracy and computer literacy skills
* Effective communication capabilities that enable you to provide clear advice and guidance
* Effective problem-solving skills and the capability to work well within a team environment
* Capacity to meet deadlines consistently
* Negotiation skills and the confidence to provide professional advice and guidance to colleagues and contractors
* Availability to travel as required across the region to fulfill site inspection accountabilities
  

  

**What's in it for you**

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action - our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world - today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:

* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network - connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's ambition to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  
  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

  
  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Location/Division Specific Information:**

**Olink**, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.

**Job description:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Data Engineer** with knowledge of AWS to contribute to the development of our internal data and analytics platform. The platform support our R&D organisation with advanced analysis tooling and data processing. In the role as Data Engineer, you will be part of a team focusing both on the core part of the platform and data ingestion pipelines as well as contributing to the development of advanced analysis tools and automations in cross functional initiatives. You will work and closely collaborate with our AI analysis team and software development team. This role is based in our Uppsala office.

  

**A Day in the Life:**

* Implement a robust and scalable environment in AWS using best practices whenever applicable.
* Design and develop robust data pipelines for ingestion and transformations
* Model and design for optimized data processing performance, ensuring efficient use of resources and adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, providing technical guidance and support to team members and stakeholders
* Contribute with up-to-date industry standards, trends, and advancements in the data engineering field, applying new techniques and technologies as appropriate.

**Requirements and skills:**
----------------------------

* Master of Science in Molecular Biotechnology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role.
* Experienced working in AWS.
* Familiarity with data modelling, data warehousing, and big data technologies.
* Strong programming skills in Python or C# is desired.
* Background in the biotech industry is beneficial.
* Knowledge of Databricks is beneficial.
* Very good English and Swedish language skills.

**Why Join Us?**

At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

The final date for submitting applications is on the 22th of October. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

new_jobs.description:
Keywords Studios, established in Dublin in 1998, now has 70+ studios across Europe, North and South America and Asia with 12,000+ employee strength located across 5 continents and 26 countries. The company provides complete outsourced game art, engineering, testing, audio and localization service for all Console, PC, Handheld and Mobile content, to many of the biggest names in games and interactive entertainment, working on thousands of titles including many of the best-selling titles of the past few years.

Keywords Studios is comprised of many individual brands, all with something unique to offer our clients. The studios are integrated into the Group by Service Line and use the operating systems and tools deployed by those services lines to ensure people and projects can operate across studios and across geographies.

Keywords Studios Asia is currently hiring for Singapore based Software Engineers.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for enthusiastic and self-motivated Software Engineers to join our Singapore-based team, working on an exciting, new, and unannounced AAA project.

This is a generalist engineering role with a strong focus on providing front-line technical support to developers. You will investigate development issues, help unblock teams, apply corrective measures where appropriate, and ensure problems are directed to the relevant system owners when deeper investigation is required.

We are hiring across mid and senior levels, with responsibilities calibrated based on experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Investigate technical issues reported by developers and perform initial analysis to identify the likely cause.
* Apply corrective measures where appropriate, including fixing or rolling back broken compilation or build issues.
* Provide operational guidance to developers to help unblock their work, for example directing them to a stable or usable build.
* Escalate and route issues or JIRAs to the appropriate system owners when further specialist investigation is required.
* Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to support development and maintain a high-quality product.
* Test, debug, and refine systems and features throughout the development cycle.
* Estimate own tasks and deliver high-quality code according to agreed schedules.
* Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and development standards.

**Requirements:**

* Professional software engineering experience in games or related real-time interactive development.
* Strong proficiency in C++ and C# knowledge.
* Good familiarity with large C++ game codebases.
* Experience working with Perforce or similar source-control systems.
* Experience with commercial game engines such as Unreal Engine and/or Unity.
* Strong debugging, investigation, and problem-solving skills.

new_jobs.description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11.2 billion.

  
  

KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers & World's Largest Public Companies. At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.

  

**Why this role?**

A CSE Engineer Project is involved in the most demanding projects. He/she takes over from the CSE Engineer, Solution in the initial start-up meeting, and is accountable for coordination of all engineering work until the project is handed over to maintenance

  

**What will you be doing?**

Solution planning – costing

* Responsible for supplying correct costings in change orders (variations and addworks), both for corporate and local materials

* Involves the Supply Line, installation, maintenance and project management to understand both the materials and service cost of the change orders (variations and addworks)

  

Solution planning – Specs

* Coordinates specification creation for changes

* Accountable for the technical content of the order between MS 0b and MS 2z

* Accountable for final technical site surveys

  

Solution planning – Availability and lead times

* Coordinates lead times from Supply Line and local sourcing on the changes

  

Solution planning – Installability

* Ensures that the proposed solution can be installed after the changes are applied

* Ensures that the cost and work effort impact of the installation is part of change costing

  

Solution planning – Maintainability

* Ensures that the proposed changes fulfils the customer’s product lifecycle needs

* Identifies possible deviations of changes to standard maintenance methods and ensures that a resolution is found

  
  

Solution planning – Compliance

* Ensures that the proposed solution fulfils local codes, regulations and safety requirements

* Ensure alignment with environmental regulations

* Ensures that the planned solution complies with KONE’s Engineering Policy

  

Key tasks in the KONE Sales process

* Takes over from the CSE Engineer, Solution in the most complex project cases during the initial start-up meeting

  

Key tasks in the KONE Delivery process

* Accountable for the creation of layouts

* Coordinates and analyses change requirements (variation orders and addworks); ensures that holistic proposals for the new solution design are provided

* Coordinates the work of all involved CSE Engineers and Specialists

* Proposes change order (variations and addworks) sales opportunities to Project Managers

* Accountable to understand variance between the design of the site versus reality of the site

* Provides solution-related information to Project Managers, Installation Supervisors and Maintenance Supervisors

  

CSE Engineer, Project role in the KONE SER process

* Shares knowledge with maintenance per as needed

  

General responsibilities

* Participates in product and new service release information-sharing sessions

* Offers input to the product offering management about customization, standardization and interface requirements for the portfolio

* Contributes to the Customer Solutions Engineering virtual and local network

* Contributes to and utilizes the Customer Solutions Engineering case library

  
  

**Are you the one?**

  

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or another relevant field, or several years’ experience in elevator business field operations

* Understanding of new construction and building modernizations processes in the industry and at KONE

* Good skills in understanding and translating customer needs into KONE technical specifications

* Good knowledge of KONE solution-related norms and standards

* Good knowledge of environmental and sustainability requirements and norms

* Good engineering tool skills e.g. CAD and BIM skills

* Good knowledge of KONE current solutions

* Knowledge of supply engineering. Good understanding on KONE supply operations

* Understanding of KONE quality management

* Good virtual collaboration skills

  

**What’s On Offer**

* Career progression in opportunities within a global organization

* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work

* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills

* You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open-minded

  

**To Be Considered**  
  
Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our Talent and Culture team will review your application and will be in contact with additional information accordingly.
  
  
In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.
